print('Replaced kalibracja block with dev/kalibracja.html contents')
PY

.heater-card {
  background: var(--g1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px;
}

.heater-card.ch0 { border-left: 2px solid var(--acc); }
.heater-card.ch1 { border-left: 2px solid var(--blue); }

.heater-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.heater-name {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.heater-badges {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}

.dev-dot {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--fg4);
  transition: background .3s, box-shadow .3s;
}

.dev-dot.on {
  background: var(--acc);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(57,211,95,.15);
}

.mode-tag {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  border: 1px solid;
}

.mode-tag.auto {
  color: var(--acc);
  border-color: rgba(57,211,95,.35);
  background: rgba(57,211,95,.08);
}

.mode-tag.man {
  color: var(--blue);
  border-color: rgba(91,174,232,.35);
  background: rgba(91,174,232,.08);
}

/* VU meter */
.vu-wrap {
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.vu-track {
  height: 5px;
  background: var(--g3);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.vu-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 2px;
  transition: width .3s ease;
}

.ch0 .vu-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--acc2), var(--acc)); }
.ch1 .vu-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3d8fb5, var(--blue)); }

.vu-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg3);
}

/* Slider row */
.slider-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.ctrl-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg3);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  min-width: 60px;
}

.ctrl-val {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
  min-width: 28px;
  text-align: right;
}

input[type="range"] {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  flex: 1;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--g3);
  border-radius: 2px;
  outline: none;
}

input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--acc);
  border: 2px solid var(--g0);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform .15s;
}

input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover { transform: scale(1.2); }
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--acc);
  border: 2px solid var(--g0);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ch1 input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: var(--blue); }
.ch1 input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { background: var(--blue); }

.btn-group {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
}

.btn {
  flex: 1;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  border: 1px solid;
  background: transparent;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .15s, color .15s;
}

.btn-man {
  color: var(--fg2);
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.btn-man:hover {
  background: var(--g3);
  color: var(--fg);
}

.btn-auto {
  color: var(--acc);
  border-color: rgba(57,211,95,.3);
  background: rgba(57,211,95,.06);
}

.btn-auto:hover { background: rgba(57,211,95,.14); }

.btn-primary {
  color: var(--acc);
  border-color: rgba(57,211,95,.3);
  background: rgba(57,211,95,.07);
}

.btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(57,211,95,.15); }

.btn-danger {
  color: var(--red);
  border-color: rgba(224,82,82,.3);
  background: rgba(224,82,82,.05);
}

.btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(224,82,82,.12); }

.btn-ghost {
  color: var(--fg3);
  border-color: var(--border2);
  font-size: 9px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
}

.btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--fg); background: var(--g2); }

/* ─── OSCILLOSCOPE ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.osc-card {
  background: var(--g1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px;
}

.osc-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.osc-title {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fg2);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
}

.osc-legend {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
}

.osc-key {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg3);
}

.leg-actual { width: 18px; height: 2px; background: var(--acc); border-radius: 1px; }
.leg-band   { width: 18px; height: 7px; background: rgba(57,211,95,.2); border-radius: 2px; }
.leg-target { width: 18px; height: 1px; background: var(--fg3); border-radius: 1px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--fg3); }

.osc-canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  background: var(--g2);
}

/* ─── DELTA ROW ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.delta-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
}

.delta-card {
  background: var(--g1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 12px;
}

.delta-title {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fg3);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.delta-value {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
  line-height: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
}

.mini-scale {
  position: relative;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--g3);
  border-radius: 2px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  overflow: visible;
}

.mini-zone-ok {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0; height: 100%;
  background: rgba(57,211,95,.25);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

.mini-scale-pin {
  position: absolute;
  top: -4px;
  width: 2px;
  height: 12px;
  background: var(--acc);
  border-radius: 1px;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  transition: left .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
}

.mini-labels {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  color: var(--fg4);
}

/* ─── BOTTOM GRID ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.bottom-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 290px;
  gap: 14px;
  align-items: start;
}

/* ─── TRAY CARDS ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.trays-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
}

.tray-card {
  background: var(--g1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px;
}

.tray-card.inactive {
  opacity: .5;
  border-color: var(--border2);
}

.tray-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tray-name {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  color: var(--fg);
}

.tray-badge {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  color: var(--acc);
  border: 1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.3);
  background: var(--acc4);
}

.tray-badge.off {
  color: var(--fg4);
  border-color: var(--border2);
  background: transparent;
}

.ring-wrap {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.pip-ring { display: block; }

.tray-stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 5px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.tstat {
  background: var(--g2);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 5px 7px;
}

.tstat-k {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  color: var(--fg4);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.tstat-v {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
}

/* Tray controls collapsed section */
.tray-controls {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border2);
  padding-top: 10px;
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
}

.ctrl-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

input[type="number"] {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  background: var(--g2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--fg);
  padding: 4px 7px;
  width: 80px;
  outline: none;
}

input[type="number"]:focus { border-color: var(--acc); }

select {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  background: var(--g2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  color: var(--fg);
  padding: 4px 7px;
  outline: none;
  flex: 1;
}

select:focus { border-color: var(--acc); }

.tray-motion {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg3);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
}

/* ─── SIDE COLUMN ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.side-col { display: grid; gap: 10px; }

.side-card {
  background: var(--g1);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px;
}

.side-card-title {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fg3);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}

/* Heater status (compact read-only in side col) */
.heater-stat {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border2);
}

.heater-stat:last-of-type {
  margin-bottom: 0;
  padding-bottom: 0;
  border-bottom: none;
}

.hstat-head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.hstat-name {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--fg2);
}

.hstat-val {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--fg);
}

/* Diffusers / Trays toggles */
.toggle-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 6px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border2);
}

.toggle-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }

.toggle-label {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--fg2);
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}

/* Toggle switch */
.pip-switch {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 32px;
  height: 18px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.pip-switch input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }

.pip-slider {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: var(--g3);
  border-radius: 9px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  transition: background .2s, border-color .2s;
}

.pip-slider::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 2px; left: 2px;
  width: 12px; height: 12px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--fg4);
  transition: transform .2s, background .2s;
}

.pip-switch input:checked + .pip-slider {
  background: rgba(57,211,95,.15);
  border-color: rgba(57,211,95,.5);
}

.pip-switch input:checked + .pip-slider::after {
  background: var(--acc);
  transform: translateX(14px);
}

/* Power table */
.power-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
}

.power-table th {
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--fg4);
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  padding: 0 0 5px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border2);
}

.power-table td {
  padding: 4px 0;
  color: var(--fg3);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border2);
}

.power-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }
.power-table td:first-child { color: var(--fg2); font-weight: 500; }
.power-table td:last-child { text-align: right; color: var(--acc); }

.ctrl-hint {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 8px;
  color: var(--fg4);
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

/* ─── STATUS MSG ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.status-msg {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--fg3);
  min-height: 14px;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
  transition: color .3s;
}

.status-msg.ok  { color: var(--acc); }
.status-msg.err { color: var(--red); }

/* ─── ANIMATIONS ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes conv {
  to { stroke-dashoffset: -20; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .mini-scale-pin { transition: none; }
  * { animation: none !important; }
}

/* ─── RESPONSIVE ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 800px) {
  .gauge-row       { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .heater-grid     { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .delta-row       { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .bottom-grid     { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .trays-grid      { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="view" id="view-status">

  <!-- HEADER -->
  <div class="pip-header">
    <div class="pip-logo">HATCH OPS // TACTICAL INCUBATION CONTROL</div>
    <div class="header-meta">
      <div class="online-pill">ONLINE · 37.8°C</div>
      <div class="clock" id="clock">00:00:00</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- GAUGES -->
  <div class="section-label">Parametry komory</div>
  <div class="gauge-row">
    <div class="gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-chamber" class="pip-canvas" width="80" height="80"></canvas>
      <div class="gauge-val" id="val-chamber">37.8°C</div>
      <div class="gauge-title">Temperatura komory</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-hum" class="pip-canvas" width="80" height="80"></canvas>
      <div class="gauge-val" id="val-hum">58%</div>
      <div class="gauge-title">DHT11 Wilgotność</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-ds18" class="pip-canvas" width="80" height="80"></canvas>
      <div class="gauge-val" id="pip-ds18-val0">37.6°C</div>
      <div class="gauge-sub" id="pip-ds18-val1">DS#2: 37.9°C</div>
      <div class="gauge-title">DS18B20 #1 / #2</div>
    </div>
    <div class="gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-esp" class="pip-canvas" width="80" height="80"></canvas>
      <div class="gauge-val" id="val-esp">42°C</div>
      <div class="gauge-title">ESP32-S3 Core</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- HEATERS -->
  <div class="section-label">Sterowanie grzałkami</div>
  <div class="heater-grid">
    <!-- CH0 -->
    <div class="heater-card ch0">
      <div class="heater-head">
        <div class="heater-name">Kanał CH0 · 48W</div>
        <div class="heater-badges">
          <div class="dev-dot on" id="led-heater0"></div>
          <div class="mode-tag auto" id="mode-heater0">AUTO</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="vu-wrap">
        <div class="vu-track"><div class="vu-fill" id="vu-fill0" style="width:0%"></div></div>
        <div class="vu-meta">
          <span>PWM 0 – 225</span>
          <span id="vu-val0">0</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="slider-row">
        <span class="ctrl-label">Moc</span>
        <input type="range" id="slider-heater0" min="0" max="225" step="1" value="0"
          oninput="updHeater(0,this.value)">
        <span class="ctrl-val" id="sv-heater0">0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-man" id="btn-heater0-man" onclick="setHeaterMode(0,'man')">Reczny</button>
        <button class="btn btn-auto" id="btn-heater0-auto" onclick="setHeaterMode(0,'auto')">AUTO</button>
      </div>
      <div class="status-msg" id="status-heater0"></div>
    </div>
    <!-- CH1 -->
    <div class="heater-card ch1">
      <div class="heater-head">
        <div class="heater-name">Kanał CH1 · 24W</div>
        <div class="heater-badges">
          <div class="dev-dot" id="led-heater1"></div>
          <div class="mode-tag auto" id="mode-heater1">AUTO</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="vu-wrap">
        <div class="vu-track"><div class="vu-fill" id="vu-fill1" style="width:0%"></div></div>
        <div class="vu-meta">
          <span>PWM 0 – 225</span>
          <span id="vu-val1">0</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="slider-row">
        <span class="ctrl-label">Moc</span>
        <input type="range" id="slider-heater1" min="0" max="225" step="1" value="0"
          oninput="updHeater(1,this.value)">
        <span class="ctrl-val" id="sv-heater1">0</span>
      </div>
      <div class="btn-group">
        <button class="btn btn-man" id="btn-heater1-man" onclick="setHeaterMode(1,'man')">Reczny</button>
        <button class="btn btn-auto" id="btn-heater1-auto" onclick="setHeaterMode(1,'auto')">AUTO</button>
      </div>
      <div class="status-msg" id="status-heater1"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- OSCILLOSCOPE -->
  <div class="osc-card">
    <div class="osc-head">
      <div class="osc-title">Temperatura komory — trend</div>
      <div class="osc-legend">
        <div class="osc-key"><div class="leg-actual"></div>aktualna</div>
        <div class="osc-key"><div class="leg-band"></div>zakres celu</div>
        <div class="osc-key"><div class="leg-target"></div>cel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <canvas id="pip-osc-temp" class="osc-canvas" height="80"></canvas>
  </div>

  <!-- DELTAS -->
  <div class="delta-row">
    <div class="delta-card">
      <div class="delta-title">DT Odchylka</div>
      <div class="delta-value" id="delta-temp-value">+0.1°C</div>
      <div class="mini-scale">
        <div class="mini-zone-ok" style="left:35%;width:30%"></div>
        <div class="mini-scale-pin" id="delta-temp-pin" style="left:52%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mini-labels"><span>-1</span><span>0</span><span>+1</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="delta-card">
      <div class="delta-title">DH Wilgotnosc</div>
      <div class="delta-value" id="delta-hum-value">OK</div>
      <div class="mini-scale">
        <div class="mini-zone-ok" style="left:30%;width:40%"></div>
        <div class="mini-scale-pin" id="delta-hum-pin" style="left:50%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mini-labels"><span>sucho</span><span>ok</span><span>mokro</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="delta-card">
      <div class="delta-title">Moc grzania</div>
      <div class="delta-value" id="heater-load-value">22%</div>
      <div class="mini-scale">
        <div class="mini-scale-pin" id="heater-load-pin" style="left:22%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mini-labels"><span>0%</span><span>50%</span><span>100%</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="delta-card">
      <div class="delta-title">Rownowaga</div>
      <div class="delta-value" id="chamber-balance-value">-0.3°C</div>
      <div class="mini-scale">
        <div class="mini-zone-ok" style="left:38%;width:24%"></div>
        <div class="mini-scale-pin" id="chamber-balance-pin" style="left:38%"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mini-labels"><span>gora</span><span>OK</span><span>dol</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- BOTTOM: TRAYS + SIDE COL -->
  <div class="bottom-grid">
    <!-- TRAYS -->
    <div>
      <div class="section-label" style="margin-bottom:10px">
        Status legów
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" onclick="showTab('kalibracja')">Kalibracja tacy</button>
      </div>
      <div class="trays-grid">
        <!-- TRAY 0 -->
        <div class="tray-card">
          <div class="tray-head">
            <div class="tray-name">TACA 1</div>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;">

<script>
/* ─────────────── CANVAS: GAUGE ────────────────────────────── */
function drawGauge(id, pct, color, bg) {
  const c = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const W = c.width, H = c.height;
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2 + 4;
  const r = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 8;
  const lw = 5;
  const startA = Math.PI * 0.75;
  const endA   = Math.PI * 2.25;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, startA, endA);
  ctx.strokeStyle = bg || 'rgba(57,211,95,.1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();
  const fillEnd = startA + (endA - startA) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, pct));
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, startA, fillEnd);
  ctx.strokeStyle = color || '#39d35f';
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.lineCap = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();
  const tickR = r - lw - 2;
  for (let i = 0; i <= 10; i++) {
    const a = startA + (endA - startA) * (i / 10);
    const x1 = cx + Math.cos(a) * (tickR - 3);
    const y1 = cy + Math.sin(a) * (tickR - 3);
    const x2 = cx + Math.cos(a) * (tickR + (i % 5 === 0 ? 6 : 3));
    const y2 = cy + Math.sin(a) * (tickR + (i % 5 === 0 ? 6 : 3));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = i % 5 === 0 ? 'rgba(57,211,95,.5)' : 'rgba(57,211,95,.2)';
    ctx.lineWidth = i % 5 === 0 ? 1.5 : .8;
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

/* ─────────────── CANVAS: RING ─────────────────────────────── */
function drawRing(id, pct, inactive) {
  const c = document.getElementById(id);
  if (!c) return;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  const W = c.width, H = c.height;
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;
  const r = Math.min(W, H) / 2 - 8;
  const lw = 7;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.1)';
  ctx.lineWidth = lw;
  ctx.stroke();
  if (!inactive && pct > 0) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + Math.PI * 2 * pct);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#39d35f';
    ctx.lineWidth = lw;
    ctx.lineCap = 'round';
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = inactive ? 'rgba(57,211,95,.2)' : 'rgba(184,245,200,.85)';
  ctx.font = `600 ${inactive ? 11 : 14}px "IBM Plex Mono", monospace`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(inactive ? 'OFF' : Math.round(pct * 100) + '%', cx, cy);
}

/* ─────────────── CANVAS: OSCILLOSCOPE ─────────────────────── */
const OSC_HISTORY = [];
const OSC_W = 640;
const OSC_TARGET = 37.8;
const OSC_RANGE  = 0.5;
const OSC_MIN    = 36.4;
const OSC_MAX    = 39.2;

function initOsc() {
  for (let i = 0; i < OSC_W; i++) {
    OSC_HISTORY.push(OSC_TARGET + Math.sin(i * 0.09) * 0.28 + Math.sin(i * 0.035) * 0.12);
  }
}

function drawOsc() {
  const c = document.getElementById('pip-osc-temp');
  if (!c) return;
  c.width = c.offsetWidth || OSC_W;
  const W = c.width, H = c.height;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  function ty(v) { return H - (v - OSC_MIN) / (OSC_MAX - OSC_MIN) * H; }

  const tyHi = ty(OSC_TARGET + OSC_RANGE);
  const tyLo = ty(OSC_TARGET - OSC_RANGE);
  const tyT  = ty(OSC_TARGET);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.07)';
  ctx.fillRect(0, tyHi, W, tyLo - tyHi);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 5]);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.22)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, tyT); ctx.lineTo(W, tyT);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();

  const step = W / OSC_HISTORY.length;
  ctx.beginPath();
  OSC_HISTORY.forEach((v, i) => {
    const x = i * step, y = ty(v);
    i === 0 ? ctx.moveTo(x, y) : ctx.lineTo(x, y);
  });
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.8)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.4;
  ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(57,211,95,.6)';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc((OSC_HISTORY.length - 1) * step, ty(OSC_HISTORY[OSC_HISTORY.length - 1]), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
}

function tickOsc(newVal) {
  OSC_HISTORY.push(newVal !== undefined ? newVal : OSC_TARGET + (Math.random() - .5) * .4);
  if (OSC_HISTORY.length > OSC_W) OSC_HISTORY.shift();
  drawOsc();
}

/* ─────────────── HEATER CONTROLS ──────────────────────────── */
function updHeater(ch, v) {
  v = parseInt(v);
  const pct = Math.round(v / 225 * 100);
  document.getElementById('vu-fill' + ch).style.width = pct + '%';
  document.getElementById('vu-val' + ch).textContent = v;
  document.getElementById('sv-heater' + ch).textContent = v;
  document.getElementById('led-heater' + ch).classList.toggle('on', v > 0);
}

function setHeaterMode(ch, mode) {
  const tag = document.getElementById('mode-heater' + ch);
  tag.textContent = mode === 'auto' ? 'AUTO' : 'MAN';
  tag.className = 'mode-tag ' + (mode === 'auto' ? 'auto' : 'man');
}

function toggleHeaterPower(ch, on) {}
function setHeaterManual(ch) { setHeaterMode(ch, 'man'); }
function setHeaterAuto(ch)   { setHeaterMode(ch, 'auto'); }

/* ─────────────── TRAY CONTROLS ────────────────────────────── */
function toggleTrayPower(idx, on) {
  const card = document.querySelectorAll('.tray-card')[idx];
  if (card) card.classList.toggle('inactive', !on);
}

function syncStatusSpecies(idx) {}
function setTrayDayStatus(idx) {}
function moveTrayStatus(idx) {}
function stopTray(idx) {}
function toggleDiffuserPower(idx, on) {
  const dot = document.getElementById('dot-diff' + idx);
  if (dot) dot.classList.toggle('on', on);
}
function showTab(name) {}

/* ─────────────── CLOCK ─────────────────────────────────────── */
function updClock() {
  const d = new Date();
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  const el = document.getElementById('clock');
  if (el) el.textContent = `${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}:${pad(d.getSeconds())}`;
}

/* ─────────────── INIT ──────────────────────────────────────── */
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  drawGauge('pip-chamber', 0.78, '#39d35f');
  drawGauge('pip-hum',     0.58, '#5baee8');
  drawGauge('pip-ds18',    0.77, '#39d35f');
  drawGauge('pip-esp',     0.42, '#f5a623');
  drawRing('pip-tray0', 0.43, false);
  drawRing('pip-tray1', 0,    true);
  initOsc();
  drawOsc();
  updClock();
  setInterval(updClock, 1000);
  setInterval(tickOsc, 2000);
  window.addEventListener('resize', drawOsc);
});
</script>
</body>

from html.parser import HTMLParser
class TagCounter(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.stack=[]
        self.errors=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
        self.stack.append(tag)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
        if not self.stack:
            self.errors.append(f'Unmatched </{tag}>')
            return
        if self.stack[-1] == tag:
            self.stack.pop()
        elif tag in self.stack:
            # auto-close intermediate tags
            while self.stack and self.stack[-1] != tag:
                self.errors.append(f'Missing </{self.stack[-1]}> before </{tag}>')
                self.stack.pop()
            if self.stack and self.stack[-1] == tag:
                self.stack.pop()
        else:
            self.errors.append(f'Unmatched </{tag}>')

class DumpParser(HTMLParser):

        super().__init__(); self.indent=0; self.pos=0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
        self.pos += 1

        self.indent += 1
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
        self.indent -= 1
        print(f'{self.getpos()[0]+lines:4} -{self.indent} </{tag}>')

class TagCounter(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.stack=[]; self.events=[]
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ("area","base","br","col","embed","hr","img","input","link","meta","param","source","track","wbr"): return
        self.stack.append(tag); self.events.append(("+",tag,self.getpos()))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ("area","base","br","col","embed","hr","img","input","link","meta","param","source","track","wbr"): return
        self.events.append(("-",tag,self.getpos()))
        if self.stack and self.stack[-1]==tag:
            self.stack.pop()
        elif tag in self.stack:
            # pop until match
            while self.stack and self.stack[-1]!=tag:
                self.stack.pop()
            if self.stack and self.stack[-1]==tag:
                self.stack.pop()
        else:
            pass

print('remaining',len(parser.stack),parser.stack[-10:])
for e in parser.events[-40:]:

```
from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser

text = Path('index.html').read_text('utf-8', errors='replace')

class TagCounter(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.stack = []
        self.errors = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input', 'link', 'meta', 'param', 'source', 'track', 'wbr'):
            return
        self.stack.append((tag, self.getpos()))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ('area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'embed', 'hr', 'img', 'input', 'link', 'meta', 'param', 'source', 'track', 'wbr'):
            return
        if not self.stack:
            self.errors.append(('unmatched', tag, self.getpos()))
            return
        if self.stack[-1][0] == tag:
            self.stack.pop()
            return
        # find matching open tag deeper in stack
        for i in range(len(self.stack) - 2, -1, -1):
            if self.stack[i][0] == tag:
                # pop everything above it as mismatched
                while len(self.stack) - 1 > i:
                    self.errors.append(('missing_close', self.stack[-1][0], self.getpos()))
                    self.stack.pop()
                self.stack.pop()
                return
        self.errors.append(('unmatched', tag, self.getpos()))

parser = TagCounter()
parser.feed(text)
print('remaining stack len', len(parser.stack))
print('remaining stack tail', parser.stack[-10:])
print('errors', parser.errors[:20])
for i, (etype, tag, pos) in enumerate(parser.errors[:20], 1):
    print(f'{i}. {etype} {tag} at {pos}')

```

```

Umieść go np. **przed** sekcją `` (oscylatorem), ale może być też w dowolnym miejscu w obrębie `view-status`.

### 3. Na samym końcu pliku, przed zamykającym `` (lub przed ``), dodaj następujący kod JavaScript:
javascript

```
// Obsługa nowych suwaków PWM (grzałki CH0 i CH1)
(function initHeaterSliders() {
  for (let ch of [0, 1]) {
    const slider = document.getElementById(`slider-heater${ch}`);
    const valSpan = document.getElementById(`val-heater${ch}`);
    const manBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-heater${ch}-man`);
    const autoBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-heater${ch}-auto`);
    const modeSpan = document.getElementById(`mode-heater${ch}`);
    const ledSpan = document.getElementById(`led-heater${ch}`);
    if (!slider) continue;

    // Wyświetlanie wartości
    slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
      valSpan.textContent = slider.value;
    });

    // Ręczny – ustaw wartość w oryginalnym suwaku i wywołaj istniejącą funkcję
    manBtn.onclick = () => {
      const pwm = parseInt(slider.value);
      if (isNaN(pwm)) return;
      const origSlider = document.getElementById(`sl-h${ch}`) || document.getElementById(`sl-main-h${ch}`);
      if (origSlider) origSlider.value = pwm;
      // Wywołaj globalną funkcję setHeaterManual (istnieje w oryginalnym kodzie)
      if (typeof setHeaterManual === 'function') setHeaterManual(ch);
      else console.warn('setHeaterManual nie zdefiniowane');
    };

    // Automat
    autoBtn.onclick = () => {
      if (typeof setHeaterAuto === 'function') setHeaterAuto(ch);
      else console.warn('setHeaterAuto nie zdefiniowane');
    };

    // Cykliczne odświeżanie stanu (tryb, PWM, dioda)
    setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof state !== 'undefined' && state.runtime) {
        const manual = state.runtime.heaterManual[ch];
        modeSpan.textContent = manual ? 'RĘCZNY' : 'AUTO';
        modeSpan.className = `mode-pill ${manual ? 'manual' : 'auto'}`;
        const pwm = state.runtime.heaterPwm[ch] || 0;
        if (!manual && slider.value != pwm) slider.value = pwm;
        valSpan.textContent = slider.value;
        const isActive = state.power.heater[ch] && pwm > 5;
        ledSpan.className = `device-dot ${isActive ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
      }
    }, 1000);
  }
})();
```

### 4. Dodaj też w `` (jeśli nie ma) definicję dla `.device-dot.on` i `.device-dot.off` – ale w Twoim oryginalnym kodzie już one są, więc nie trzeba.

## Dlaczego to zadziała?

- Nie usuwasz żadnych istniejących elementów ani funkcji.
- Wykorzystujesz oryginalne, sprawdzone funkcje `setHeaterManual(ch)` i `setHeaterAuto(ch)`, które już działają (są w Twoim kodzie).
- Nowe suwaki są niezależne – jedynie na żądanie "ręczne" ustawiają wartość w oryginalnym suwaku (`sl-h0` itp.) i wywołują tę samą funkcję, którą i tak używasz.
- Dioda LED i znacznik trybu są aktualizowane na bieżąco na podstawie globalnego obiektu `state` (który jest aktualizowany przez `updateAll`).

from pathlib import Path
from textwrap import dedent

insert_code = dedent("""
(function initHeaterSliders() {
  for (let ch of [0, 1]) {
    const slider = document.getElementById(`slider-heater${ch}`);
    const valSpan = document.getElementById(`val-heater${ch}`);
    const manBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-heater${ch}-man`);
    const autoBtn = document.getElementById(`btn-heater${ch}-auto`);
    const modeSpan = document.getElementById(`mode-heater${ch}`);
    const ledSpan = document.getElementById(`led-heater${ch}`);
    if (!slider) continue;

    slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
      if (valSpan) valSpan.textContent = slider.value;
    });

    if (manBtn) {
      manBtn.onclick = () => {
        const pwm = parseInt(slider.value, 10);
        if (Number.isNaN(pwm)) return;
        const origSlider = document.getElementById(`sl-h${ch}`) || document.getElementById(`sl-main-h${ch}`);
        if (origSlider) origSlider.value = pwm;
        if (typeof setHeaterManual === 'function') setHeaterManual(ch);
        else console.warn('setHeaterManual nie zdefiniowane');
      };
    }

    if (autoBtn) {
      autoBtn.onclick = () => {
        if (typeof setHeaterAuto === 'function') setHeaterAuto(ch);
        else console.warn('setHeaterAuto nie zdefiniowane');
      };
    }

    setInterval(() => {
      if (typeof state !== 'undefined' && state.runtime) {
        const manual = state.runtime.heaterManual?.[ch];
        if (modeSpan) {
          modeSpan.textContent = manual ? 'RĘCZNY' : 'AUTO';
          modeSpan.className = `mode-pill ${manual ? 'manual' : 'auto'}`;
        }
        const pwm = state.runtime.heaterPwm?.[ch] || 0;
        if (!manual && slider.value !== String(pwm)) slider.value = pwm;
        if (valSpan) valSpan.textContent = slider.value;
        const isActive = state.power?.heater?.[ch] && pwm > 5;
        if (ledSpan) ledSpan.className = `device-dot ${isActive ? 'on' : 'off'}`;
      }
    }, 1000);
  }
})();

""")

for rel in ['index.html', 'firmware/data/index.html']:
    path = Path(rel)
    text = path.read_text('utf-8', errors='replace')
    if 'function initHeaterSliders' in text:
        print(f'{rel}: already present')
        continue
    marker = 'runWhenReady(()=>{'
    idx = text.find(marker)
    if idx == -1:
        raise SystemExit(f'Could not find insertion marker in {rel}')
    insert_pos = idx
    new_text = text[:insert_pos] + insert_code + text[insert_pos:]
    path.write_text(new_text, 'utf-8')
    print(f'{rel}: inserted')

from pathlib import Path
from html.parser import HTMLParser

for rel in ['index.html', 'firmware/data/index.html']:
    text = Path(rel).read_text('utf-8', errors='replace')
    class TagCounter(HTMLParser):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.stack = []
            self.errors = []
        def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
            if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
            self.stack.append((tag, self.getpos()))
        def handle_endtag(self, tag):
            if tag in ('area','base','br','col','embed','hr','img','input','link','meta','param','source','track','wbr'): return
            if not self.stack:
                self.errors.append(('unmatched', tag, self.getpos())); return
            if self.stack[-1][0] == tag:
                self.stack.pop(); return
            for i in range(len(self.stack)-2,-1,-1):
                if self.stack[i][0]==tag:
                    while len(self.stack)-1>i:
                        self.errors.append(('missing_close', self.stack[-1][0], self.getpos())); self.stack.pop()
                    self.stack.pop(); return
            self.errors.append(('unmatched', tag, self.getpos()))
    parser = TagCounter(); parser.feed(text)
    print(rel)
    print('remaining stack', len(parser.stack), parser.stack[-10:])
    print('errors', parser.errors[:20])
    print('---')

### Dlaczego widzisz stary kod
Najprawdopodobniej:
- przeglądarka pokazuje zbuforowaną stronę,
- lub `Go Live` serwuje inny plik niż `index.html`.

### Co zrobić
1. Otwórz dokładnie `http://127.0.0.1:5500/index.html`
2. Wymuś odświeżenie:
   - `Ctrl+F5`
   - lub otwórz stronę w trybie incognito
3. Sprawdź źródło strony (`Ctrl+U`) czy zawiera `pip-heat-control-section`

Jeśli chcesz, mogę też pomóc zweryfikować, którą ścieżkę `Go Live` serwuje teraz i czy serwer nie wskazuje na inny folder.

import re
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile, subprocess
text = Path('index.html').read_text('utf8', errors='replace')
scripts = re.findall(r'<script[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)</script>', text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
node_code = """
const fs = require('fs');
const vm = require('vm');
const code = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
const scripts = JSON.parse(code);
for (let i=0; i<scripts.length; i++) {
  try {
    new vm.Script(scripts[i]);
    console.log('script', i+1, 'ok');
  } catch(e) {
    console.error('script', i+1, 'error', e.message);
    if (e.lineNumber) console.error('line', e.lineNumber, 'column', e.columnNumber);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}
"""
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', suffix='.json', delete=False, encoding='utf8') as f:
    f.write(str(scripts).replace('"', '\\"').replace("\\n", "\\n"))
    json_path = f.name
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', suffix='.js', delete=False, encoding='utf8') as jsf:
    jsf.write(node_code)
    js_path = jsf.name
res = subprocess.run(['node', js_path, json_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
print('returncode', res.returncode)
print('stdout:\n', res.stdout)
print('stderr:\n', res.stderr)

```

      <div>
        <div class="logo">INKUBATOR FUZZY v1</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">Prototyp regulatora rozmytego inspirowany eFLL dla ESP/Arduino</div>
      </div>
      <div class="mode" id="status-mode">AUTO (Fuzzy)</div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-3">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Temperatura komory</div>
        <div class="metric-big" id="disp-temp">--°C</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">Zadana temperatura: <span id="disp-target">37.8°C</span></div>
        <div class="bar"><div class="bar-fill" id="temp-bar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Wyjście rozmyte</div>
        <div class="metric-big" id="disp-fuzzy">0%</div>
        <div class="metric-sub">sterowanie mocą grzałek</div>
        <div class="bar"><div class="bar-fill" id="fuzzy-bar" style="width:0%"></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Aktualne nastawy</div>
        <div class="label-grid"><span>Błąd</span><strong id="disp-error">--°C</strong></div>
        <div class="label-grid"><span>d(e)/dt</span><strong id="disp-deriv">--</strong></div>
        <div class="label-grid"><span>Tryb</span><strong id="disp-mode">AUTO</strong></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-2" style="margin-top:18px;">
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Fuzzy Logic (eFLL style)</div>
        <p class="metric-sub">Model używa 5 trójkątnych funkcji przynależności dla błędu (e) i zmiany błędu (de). Wynik defuzyfikowany jest metodą centroidu.</p>
        <div class="log" id="fuzzy-log"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="card-title">Kontrola grzałek</div>
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>CH0 PWM <span id="disp-ch0">0</span></label>
          <input type="range" min="0" max="225" value="0" id="slider-ch0">
        </div>
        <div class="control-row">
          <label>CH1 PWM <span id="disp-ch1">0</span></label>
          <input type="range" min="0" max="225" value="0" id="slider-ch1">
        </div>
        <div class="btn-group">
          <button id="btn-manual">Ręczny tryb</button>
          <button id="btn-auto">AUTO fuzzy</button>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-note">W trybie AUTO suwaki służą tylko podglądowi działania regulatora.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    const state = {
      temp: 37.0,
      target: 37.8,
      lastTemp: 37.0,
      mode: 'AUTO',
      fuzzyOutput: 0,
      pwm0: 0,
      pwm1: 0,
      manualOverride: false,
      fuzzyRules: []
    };

    const membershipSets = {
      NB: x => trapezoid(x, -10, -10, -4, -2),
      NS: x => triangle(x, -4, -2, 0),
      ZE: x => triangle(x, -1, 0, 1),
      PS: x => triangle(x, 0, 2, 4),
      PB: x => trapezoid(x, 2, 4, 10, 10)
    };

    const fuzzyLabels = ['NB','NS','ZE','PS','PB'];

    function triangle(x, a, b, c) {
      if (x <= a || x >= c) return 0;
      if (x <= b) return (x - a) / (b - a);
      return (c - x) / (c - b);
    }
    function trapezoid(x, a, b, c, d) {
      if (x <= a || x >= d) return 0;
      if (x <= b) return (x - a) / (b - a);
      if (x >= c) return (d - x) / (d - c);
      return 1;
    }

    function buildFuzzyRules() {
      const matrix = {
        NB: { NB: PB, NS: PB, ZE: PS, PS: ZE, PB: ZE },
        NS: { NB: PB, NS: PS, ZE: PS, PS: ZE, PB: NS },
        ZE: { NB: PS, NS: PS, ZE: ZE, PS: NS, PB: NS },
        PS: { NB: PS, NS: ZE, ZE: NS, PS: NB, PB: NB },
        PB: { NB: ZE, NS: NS, ZE: NS, PS: NB, PB: NB }
      };
      for (const e of fuzzyLabels) {
        for (const de of fuzzyLabels) {
          state.fuzzyRules.push({ e, de, out: matrix[e][de] });
        }
      }
    }

    function fuzzify(value) {
      const out = {};
      for (const label of fuzzyLabels) {
        out[label] = membershipSets[label](value);
      }
      return out;
    }

    function defuzzify(outputActivations) {
      const weights = { NB: 0, NS: 25, ZE: 50, PS: 75, PB: 100 };
      let numerator = 0, denominator = 0;
      for (const label of fuzzyLabels) {
        const alpha = outputActivations[label] || 0;
        numerator += alpha * weights[label];
        denominator += alpha;
      }
      return denominator ? numerator / denominator : 0;
    }

    function evaluateFuzzy(error, derivative) {
      const eFuzzy = fuzzify(error);
      const deFuzzy = fuzzify(derivative);
      const aggregated = { NB:0, NS:0, ZE:0, PS:0, PB:0 };
      const activations = [];
      for (const rule of state.fuzzyRules) {
        const alpha = Math.min(eFuzzy[rule.e], deFuzzy[rule.de]);
        if (alpha > 0) {
          aggregated[rule.out] = Math.max(aggregated[rule.out], alpha);
          activations.push(`${rule.e}/${rule.de}→${rule.out} (${alpha.toFixed(2)})`);
        }
      }
      updateLog(activations.slice(-6));
      return defuzzify(aggregated);
    }

    function updateState() {
      const error = state.target - state.temp;
      const derivative = state.temp - state.lastTemp;
      state.lastTemp = state.temp;
      const fuzzyOutput = evaluateFuzzy(error, derivative);
      state.fuzzyOutput = fuzzyOutput;
      const pwm = Math.round(fuzzyOutput * 2.25);
      if (!state.manualOverride) {
        state.pwm0 = Math.min(225, pwm);
        state.pwm1 = Math.min(225, Math.round(pwm * 0.55));
      }
      renderDisplay(error, derivative);
    }

    function renderDisplay(error, derivative) {
      document.getElementById('disp-temp').textContent = state.temp.toFixed(1) + '°C';
      document.getElementById('disp-target').textContent = state.target.toFixed(1) + '°C';
      document.getElementById('disp-error').textContent = error.toFixed(2) + '°C';
      document.getElementById('disp-deriv').textContent = derivative.toFixed(3) + '°C/s';
      document.getElementById('disp-fuzzy').textContent = state.fuzzyOutput.toFixed(0) + '%';
      document.getElementById('temp-bar').style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (state.temp - 30)*10)) + '%';
      document.getElementById('fuzzy-bar').style.width = state.fuzzyOutput.toFixed(0) + '%';
      document.getElementById('disp-ch0').textContent = state.pwm0;
      document.getElementById('disp-ch1').textContent = state.pwm1;
      document.getElementById('slider-ch0').value = state.pwm0;
      document.getElementById('slider-ch1').value = state.pwm1;
      document.getElementById('status-mode').textContent = state.manualOverride ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO (Fuzzy)';
      document.getElementById('disp-mode').textContent = state.manualOverride ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO';
    }

    function updateLog(entries) {
      const log = document.getElementById('fuzzy-log');
      const now = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL');
      log.innerHTML = entries.map(line => `<p>${now} • ${line}</p>`).join('') + log.innerHTML;
      while (log.children.length > 8) log.removeChild(log.lastChild);
    }

    function setManualMode(enable) {
      state.manualOverride = enable;
      document.getElementById('status-mode').textContent = enable ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO (Fuzzy)';
      document.getElementById('disp-mode').textContent = enable ? 'MANUAL' : 'AUTO';
    }

    function simulateHeat() {
      const ambient = 22.5;
      const power = (state.pwm0 + state.pwm1) / 450;
      state.temp += (power * 0.18) - (state.temp - ambient) * 0.03;
      state.temp = Math.max(ambient, state.temp);
      renderDisplay(state.target - state.temp, state.temp - state.lastTemp);
    }

    document.getElementById('slider-ch0').addEventListener('input', e => {
      state.pwm0 = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
      document.getElementById('disp-ch0').textContent = state.pwm0;
    });
    document.getElementById('slider-ch1').addEventListener('input', e => {
      state.pwm1 = parseInt(e.target.value, 10);
      document.getElementById('disp-ch1').textContent = state.pwm1;
    });
    document.getElementById('btn-manual').addEventListener('click', () => setManualMode(true));
    document.getElementById('btn-auto').addEventListener('click', () => setManualMode(false));

    buildFuzzyRules();
    setInterval(() => {
      if (!state.manualOverride) updateState();
      simulateHeat();
    }, 2000);
    setInterval(simulateHeat, 1000);
    renderDisplay(0,0);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

```

from pathlib import Path
import re
from datetime import datetime
root = Path(r'J:/inkubator')
backup = root / 'backups'
latest = None
for p in backup.rglob('index.html'):
    if 'node_modules' in p.parts:
        continue
    name = p.name
    rel = p.relative_to(backup)
    # look for backup timestamp in path
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}_\d{6})', str(rel))
    if m:
        try:
            dt = datetime.strptime(m.group(1), '%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')
        except ValueError:
            dt = datetime.min
    else:
        dt = datetime.min
    if latest is None or dt > latest[0]:
        latest = (dt, p)
if latest is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError('No index.html found in backups')
source = latest[1]
target = root / 'indexv0.html'
print('copying', source, '->', target)
target.write_text(source.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8')
print('done')

(function(){
/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
   KALIBRACJA TACY — logika JS (poprawiona)
────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const KAL = {
  pwm: 40,
  phase: '0→MAX_P',
  swRunning: false,
  swStart: 0,
  swElapsed: 0,
  swLapBase: 0,
  laps: [],
  measurements: [],
  decayActive: false,
  decayStartTs: 0,
  decayStopTs: 0,
  decaySamples: [],
  decayTimer: null,
  angle: 0,
  targetAngle: 0,
  posLabel: 'POZIOM 0',
  animRaf: null,
  prefConfig: null,
  autoLapEnabled: false,
  autoLapTimer: null,
  seqCount: 10,
  seqRunning: false,
  seqTimer: null,
  seqStartTs: 0,
  seqDurationMs: 0,
};

/* ----- helpery ----- */
function fmtMs(ms){
  const m=Math.floor(ms/60000);
  const s=Math.floor((ms%60000)/1000);
  const mil=Math.floor(ms%1000);
  return String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(s).padStart(2,'0')+'.'+String(mil).padStart(3,'0');
}
function fmtMsShort(ms){ return (ms/1000).toFixed(3)+'s'; }

/* ----- API dla ruchu tacy ----- */
window.kalApiMove = function(direction){
  const tray = parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
  const pwmRaw = Math.round((KAL.pwm / 100) * 255);
  const durationMs = 3000; // domyślny czas testowy
  const statusDiv = document.getElementById('kal-api-status');
  if(statusDiv) statusDiv.textContent = '⏳ Wysyłanie komendy...';
  fetchJson('/api/tray/move?tray='+tray+'&duration_ms='+durationMs+'&pwm_speed='+pwmRaw, {method:'POST'}, 3000)
    .then(d => {
      if(d && d.ok) statusDiv.textContent = '✓ Ruch '+(direction==='right'?'PRAWO':'LEWO')+' uruchomiony';
      else statusDiv.textContent = '⚠ Błąd API: '+(d?.error||'nieznany');
    })
    .catch(() => { statusDiv.textContent = '⚠ Brak połączenia z API'; });
};
window.kalApiStop = function(){
  const tray = parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
  const statusDiv = document.getElementById('kal-api-status');
  statusDiv.textContent = '⏳ Zatrzymywanie...';
  fetchJson('/api/tray/stop?tray='+tray, {method:'POST'}, 3000)
    .then(d => { statusDiv.textContent = d?.ok ? '✓ Zatrzymano' : '⚠ Błąd'; })
    .catch(() => { statusDiv.textContent = '⚠ Brak połączenia'; });
};

/* ----- Rejestracja próbek decay (OFF ALL) ----- */
window.kalRecordDecaySample = function(s){
  if(!KAL.decayActive) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  const temp = s.temp_chamber;
  const hum = s.humidity;
  if(temp !== undefined && hum !== undefined){
    KAL.decaySamples.push({ts: now, temp, hum});
    if(KAL.decaySamples.length > 200) KAL.decaySamples.shift();
    kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
  }
};

/* ----- Rysowanie poziomnicy (wizualizacja kąta) ----- */
window.drawTray = function(angle){
  const canvas = document.getElementById('kal-canvas');
  if(!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const w = canvas.clientWidth, h = canvas.clientHeight;
  canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  const cx = w/2, cy = h/2 + 10;
  const rectW = w*0.5, rectH = h*0.2;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.rotate(angle * Math.PI/180);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2a5a3a';
  ctx.fillRect(-rectW/2, -rectH/2, rectW, rectH);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#39d35f';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.strokeRect(-rectW/2, -rectH/2, rectW, rectH);
  // bąbelek (poziomnica)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5dd4ff';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(0, 0, rectH*0.3, 0, Math.PI*2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  // linie pomocnicze
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy-40); ctx.lineTo(cx, cy+40);
  ctx.moveTo(cx-40, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx+40, cy);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(245,166,35,0.6)';
  ctx.setLineDash([5,5]);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  document.getElementById('kal-angle-val').innerText = angle.toFixed(1)+'°';
  document.getElementById('kal-pos-label').innerText = KAL.posLabel;
};
window.kalAnimateTo = function(targetAngle, label){
  if(KAL.animRaf) cancelAnimationFrame(KAL.animRaf);
  const startAngle = KAL.angle;
  const duration = 300;
  const startTime = performance.now();
  KAL.targetAngle = targetAngle;
  KAL.posLabel = label;
  function step(now){
    const t = Math.min(1, (now - startTime) / duration);
    const newAngle = startAngle + (targetAngle - startAngle) * t;
    KAL.angle = newAngle;
    drawTray(KAL.angle);
    if(t a+b.ms,0)/meas.length;
  const avgPwm = meas.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.pwm,0)/meas.length;
  const speeds = [...new Set(meas.map(m=>m.pwm))];
  const best = meas.reduce((best,m)=> (m.ms  (m.ms > worst.ms ? m : worst), meas[0]);
  const html = `
    Średni czas${(avgTime/1000).toFixed(2)} s

    Średnie PWM${avgPwm.toFixed(1)}%

    Najlepszy czas${(best.ms/1000).toFixed(2)} s @ ${best.pwm}%

    Najgorszy czas${(worst.ms/1000).toFixed(2)} s @ ${worst.pwm}%

    Testowane PWM${speeds.join(', ')}%

  `;
  document.getElementById('kal-calc-content').innerHTML = html;
  document.getElementById('kal-calc-box').style.display = 'block';
};
window.kalExportCSV = function(){
  const rows = [['#','Faza','PWM%','Czas(ms)','Czas(s)','Timestamp']];
  KAL.measurements.forEach((m,i)=>{
    rows.push([i+1, m.label, m.pwm, m.ms, (m.ms/1000).toFixed(3), new Date(m.ts).toLocaleString()]);
  });
  const csv = rows.map(r=>r.join(',')).join('\n');
  const blob = new Blob([csv], {type:'text/csv'});
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = 'pomiary_tacy_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,19)+'.csv';
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
};

/* ----- reszta oryginalnych funkcji (bez zmian) ----- */
window.kalToggleAutoLap = function(){
  KAL.autoLapEnabled = !KAL.autoLapEnabled;
  const btn = document.getElementById('kal-auto-lap-btn');
  if(btn) btn.textContent = 'AUTO LAP: '+(KAL.autoLapEnabled?'ON':'OFF');
  if(KAL.autoLapEnabled && KAL.swRunning) kalScheduleAutoLap();
};
function kalScheduleAutoLap(){
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer) clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
  if(!KAL.autoLapEnabled || !KAL.swRunning) return;
  const sec = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('kal-auto-lap-sec')?.value || 33));
  KAL.autoLapTimer = setTimeout(()=>{ if(KAL.swRunning) kalSwLap(); }, sec*1000);
}
window.kalSeqSetCount = function(n){
  KAL.seqCount = n;
  [1,3,5,10,20,50].forEach(v=>{
    const btn = document.getElementById('kal-seq-c'+v);
    if(btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', v===n);
  });
  const runBtn = document.getElementById('kal-seq-run');
  if(runBtn) runBtn.textContent = '▶ Uruchom '+n+'×';
  kalSeqUpdateTotal();
};
function kalSeqUpdateTotal(){
  const halfSec = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec')?.value || 33));
  const total = halfSec * KAL.seqCount;
  const m = Math.floor(total/60), s = Math.round(total%60);
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-total').textContent = total.toFixed(1)+'s = '+m+'m '+String(s).padStart(2,'0')+'s';
}
function kalSeqTick(){
  if(!KAL.seqRunning) return;
  const elapsed = Date.now() - KAL.seqStartTs;
  const remaining = Math.max(0, KAL.seqDurationMs - elapsed);
  const halfSec = Math.max(1, Number(document.getElementById('kal-seq-half-sec')?.value || 33));
  const halfMs = halfSec*1000;
  const currentHalf = Math.min(KAL.seqCount, Math.floor(elapsed/halfMs)+1);
  const prog = document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
  if(prog) prog.textContent = '▶ półcykl '+currentHalf+'/'+KAL.seqCount+' · pozostało '+Math.ceil(remaining/1000)+'s';
  if(remaining  {
      prog.textContent = d?.ok ? '▶ uruchomiono' : '⚠ API: '+(d?.error||'błąd');
      if(KAL.seqTimer) clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);
      KAL.seqTimer = setInterval(kalSeqTick, 500);
    })
    .catch(() => {
      prog.textContent = '⚠ offline — odliczanie lokalne';
      if(KAL.seqTimer) clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);
      KAL.seqTimer = setInterval(kalSeqTick, 500);
    });
};
window.kalSeqStop = function(manual, finished){
  if(!KAL.seqRunning && !finished) return;
  KAL.seqRunning = false;
  if(KAL.seqTimer) clearInterval(KAL.seqTimer);
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-run').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('kal-seq-stop').disabled = true;
  const prog = document.getElementById('kal-seq-progress');
  if(finished) prog.textContent = '✓ zakończono '+KAL.seqCount+'× półcykli';
  else prog.textContent = '■ zatrzymano';
  if(manual){
    const tray = parseInt(document.getElementById('kal-tray-sel').value);
    fetchJson('/api/tray/stop?tray='+tray, {method:'POST'}, 3000).catch(()=>{});
  }
};

/* ----- Preferencje tac (wczytywanie/zapis) ----- */
function kalSetPrefStatus(msg,err){
  const el = document.getElementById('kal-pref-status');
  if(el){ el.textContent = msg; el.style.color = err ? 'var(--hot)' : 'var(--muted)'; }
}
function kalFillPrefInputsFromTrays(trays){
  for(let i=0;ib.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.textContent)===+v));
};
window.kalSetPwm = function(v){
  KAL.pwm = v;
  document.getElementById('kal-pwm-slider').value = v;
  document.getElementById('kal-pwm-disp').textContent = v;
  document.querySelectorAll('.kal-preset').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.textContent)===v));
};
window.kalSelectPhase = function(el, phase){
  KAL.phase = phase;
  document.querySelectorAll('.kal-phase-btn').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('sel'));
  el.classList.add('sel');
};

/* ----- Stoper ----- */
let swTimer = null;
function swTick(){
  if(!KAL.swRunning) return;
  const now = performance.now();
  const total = KAL.swElapsed + (now - KAL.swStart);
  const lap = total - KAL.swLapBase;
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-main').textContent = fmtMs(lap);
  document.getElementById('kal-clock-sub').textContent = 'Łącznie: '+fmtMs(total)+' · Okrążeń: '+KAL.laps.length;
  swTimer = requestAnimationFrame(swTick);
}
window.kalSwStart = function(){
  if(KAL.swRunning) return;
  KAL.swRunning = true;
  KAL.swStart = performance.now();
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-start').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-stop').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-lap').disabled = false;
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer) clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
  kalApiMove('right');
  kalScheduleAutoLap();
  swTick();
};
window.kalSwStop = function(){
  if(!KAL.swRunning) return;
  KAL.swElapsed += (performance.now() - KAL.swStart);
  KAL.swRunning = false;
  if(swTimer) cancelAnimationFrame(swTimer);
  if(KAL.autoLapTimer) clearTimeout(KAL.autoLapTimer);
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-start').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('kal-sw-stop').disabled = true;
  kalSwLap();
  kalApiStop();
};
window.kalSwLap = function(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const total = KAL.swElapsed + (KAL.swRunning ? (now - KAL.swStart) : 0);
  const lap = total - KAL.swLapBase;
  if(lap `${i+1}. ${l.label}${l.pwm}%${fmtMs(l.ms)}
`).reverse().join('');
}
function renderMeasurements(){
  const body = document.getElementById('kal-meas-body');
  if(!KAL.measurements.length){
    body.innerHTML = 'Brak danych — naciśnij ⊙ LAP podczas pomiaru';
    return;
  }
  body.innerHTML = KAL.measurements.map((m,i)=>{
    const cls = m.pwm>=90 ? 'hi' : (m.pwm>=60 ? 'med' : 'lo');
    return `
      ${i+1}
      ${m.label}
      ${m.pwm}%
      ${m.ms.toLocaleString('pl')}
      ${(m.ms/1000).toFixed(3)}
      ${new Date(m.ts).toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL')}
      ✕
    `;
  }).join('');
}
window.kalDelMeasurement = function(i){
  KAL.measurements.splice(i,1);
  renderMeasurements();
  kalUpdateCalc();
};
window.kalClearMeasurements = function(){
  if(!KAL.measurements.length) return;
  if(!confirm('Wyczyścić wszystkie pomiary?')) return;
  KAL.measurements = [];
  renderMeasurements();
  document.getElementById('kal-calc-box').style.display = 'none';
};

/* ----- OFF ALL (pomiar rozpadu) ----- */
window.kalOffAllStart = function(){
  if(KAL.decayActive) return;
  KAL.decayActive = true;
  KAL.decayStartTs = Date.now();
  KAL.decaySamples = [];
  if(KAL.decayTimer) clearInterval(KAL.decayTimer);
  const statusDiv = document.getElementById('kal-decay-status');
  if(statusDiv) statusDiv.textContent = '⏳ OFF ALL rozpoczęty — zbieranie próbek...';
  document.getElementById('kal-offall-start').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('kal-offall-stop').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('kal-offall-clear').disabled = true;
  if(window.globalPowerOff) window.globalPowerOff();
  KAL.decayTimer = setInterval(()=>{
    const duration = (Date.now() - KAL.decayStartTs)/1000;
    if(statusDiv) statusDiv.textContent = '⏳ OFF ALL w toku: '+duration.toFixed(1)+'s';
    kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
  }, 1000);
};
window.kalOffAllStop = function(){
  if(!KAL.decayActive) return;
  KAL.decayActive = false;
  KAL.decayStopTs = Date.now();
  if(KAL.decayTimer) clearInterval(KAL.decayTimer);
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-status').textContent = '✓ Pomiar OFF ALL zatrzymany.';
  document.getElementById('kal-offall-start').disabled = false;
  document.getElementById('kal-offall-stop').disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('kal-offall-clear').disabled = false;
  kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
};
window.kalClearDecay = function(){
  KAL.decayActive = false;
  if(KAL.decayTimer) clearInterval(KAL.decayTimer);
  KAL.decaySamples = [];
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-status').textContent = '✓ Stan OFF ALL wyczyszczony.';
  kalUpdateDecayCalculations();
};
function kalUpdateDecayCalculations(){
  const samples = KAL.decaySamples.length;
  const box = document.getElementById('kal-decay-box');
  if(box) box.style.display = samples ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-duration').textContent = samples ? Math.round((Date.now()-KAL.decayStartTs)/1000)+' s' : '0 s';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-rate').textContent = '-- °C/h';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-rate').textContent = '-- %/h';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-samples').textContent = samples;
}

/* ----- Inicjalizacja ----- */
drawTray(0);
})();

from pathlib import Path
import datetime, shutil
root = Path(r'J:/inkubator')
data = root / 'firmware' / 'data'
backup_root = root / 'backups' / f'firmware_data_pruned_{datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S")}'
backup_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
removed = []
for item in ['documentation_v1_1.html','kalibracja.html','dev']:
    src = data / item
    if src.exists():
        dst = backup_root / item

_**Agent (copilot/oswe-vscode-prime)**_

Tak, działało, tylko start faktycznie może być dłuższy.

### Co ustaliłem
- `COM7` pokazał, że firmware został wgrany i ESP się zresetowało.
- Następnie uruchomiono Wi-Fi/AP z `main.cpp`.

### Dlaczego start był wolny
W `firmware/src/main.cpp` jest blok:
- jeśli `WIFI_STA_SSID` jest ustawione, ESP próbuje połączyć się najpierw jako klient Wi-Fi
- czeka do 20 sekund (`while (...) && millis() - sta_start < 20000`)
- dopiero potem włącza AP

To dokładnie pasuje do tego, że start wydawał się długi.

### Wniosek
- tak, upload + reset + połączenie Wi-Fi mogą trwać
- jeśli chcesz szybszy start AP, usuń/wyczyść ustawienia STA lub skróć timeout połączenia w `main.cpp`

Jeśli chcesz, mogę teraz znaleźć i zmienić ten timeout / wyłączyć STA w kodzie.

Wprowadziłem zmianę w `main.cpp` i zacząłem przesyłać nowy firmware, ale upload się nie powiódł, ponieważ `COM7` jest zajęty.

### Co zostało zmienione
- STA zostało wyłączone w kodzie
- ESP będzie teraz startować tylko w trybie AP
- ustawienia STA pozostały w kodzie do późniejszego użycia

### Problem teraz
- `platformio upload` nie może otworzyć `COM7` (port zajęty)

### Co proponuję
1. Zamknij serial monitor / inne narzędzie korzystające z `COM7`
2. Spróbuj ponownie:
   - `platformio run --environment esp32s3 --target upload`
   - następnie `platformio run --environment esp32s3 --target uploadfs`

Jeśli chcesz, mogę też sprawdzić, czy `COM7` jest obecnie zablokowany przez proces lub poprzedni monitor.
