] map[filePath:J:\inkubator\firmware\src\main.cpp newString:void csv_create_header() {
  File f = LittleFS.open("/inkubator_log.csv", "w");
  if (f) {
    f.println("time_sec,temp_chamber,temp_secondary,humidity,water_level,door,heater_pct");
    f.close();
  }
}

static uint64_t sample_timestamp_ms(const SensorData& data) {
  if (rtc_ok && incubation_start_unix > 0) {
    DateTime now = rtc.now();
    return (uint64_t)now.unixtime() * 1000ULL + (data.elapsed_ms % 1000ULL);
  }
  return data.elapsed_ms;
}

static SensorSample make_sensor_sample(const SensorData& data) {
  SensorSample sample = {};
  sample.timestamp_ms = sample_timestamp_ms(data);
  sample.flags = 0;

  if (data.temp[0] > -50.0f && data.temp[0] < 120.0f) {
    sample.temp_chamber_x10 = (int16_t)round(data.temp[0] * 10.0f);
    sample.flags |= 0x0001;
  } else {
    sample.temp_chamber_x10 = INT16_MIN;
  }

  if (data.temp[1] > -50.0f && data.temp[1] < 120.0f) {
    sample.temp_secondary_x10 = (int16_t)round(data.temp[1] * 10.0f);
    sample.flags |= 0x0002;
  } else {
    sample.temp_secondary_x10 = INT16_MIN;
  }

  if (data.humidity >= 0.0f && data.humidity <= 100.0f) {
    sample.humidity_x10 = (int16_t)round(data.humidity * 10.0f);
    sample.flags |= 0x0004;
  } else {
    sample.humidity_x10 = INT16_MIN;
  }

  if (data.door_open) sample.flags |= 0x0008;
  if (data.water_level >= 0 && data.water_level > 2048) sample.flags |= 0x0010;

  return sample;
}

static bool sample_is_significant(const SensorSample& a, const SensorSample& b) {
  if (a.flags != b.flags) return true;
  if ((a.flags & 0x0001) && (b.flags & 0x0001)) {
    if (abs(a.temp_chamber_x10 - b.temp_chamber_x10) >= (int)(SAMPLE_TEMP_DELTA_THRESH * 10.0f)) return true;
  }
  if ((a.flags & 0x0002) && (b.flags & 0x0002)) {
    if (abs(a.temp_secondary_x10 - b.temp_secondary_x10) >= (int)(SAMPLE_TEMP_DELTA_THRESH * 10.0f)) return true;
  }
  if ((a.flags & 0x0004) && (b.flags & 0x0004)) {
    if (abs(a.humidity_x10 - b.humidity_x10) >= (int)(SAMPLE_HUM_DELTA_THRESH * 10.0f)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

static bool sample_requires_immediate_flush(const SensorSample& a, const SensorSample& b) {
  if ((a.flags & 0x0001) && (b.flags & 0x0001)) {
    if (abs(a.temp_chamber_x10 - b.temp_chamber_x10) >= (int)(FLASH_IMMEDIATE_TEMP_DELTA * 10.0f)) return true;
  }
  if ((a.flags & 0x0004) && (b.flags & 0x0004)) {
    if (abs(a.humidity_x10 - b.humidity_x10) >= (int)(FLASH_IMMEDIATE_HUM_DELTA * 10.0f)) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

static void sample_buffer_append(const SensorSample& sample) {
  sample_buffer[sample_buffer_head] = sample;
  sample_buffer_head = (sample_buffer_head + 1) % SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE;
  if (sample_buffer_pending < SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE) {
    sample_buffer_pending++;
  }
  last_sample = sample;
  has_last_sample = true;
}

static void flush_sample_buffer_to_flash() {
  if (sample_buffer_pending == 0) return;
  File f = LittleFS.open(SAMPLE_FILE_PATH, "a");
  if (!f) {
    Serial.println("[LOG] Failed to open sample file for flush");
    return;
  }

  size_t start = (sample_buffer_head + SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE - sample_buffer_pending) % SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < sample_buffer_pending; i++) {
    size_t idx = start + i;
    if (idx >= SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE) idx -= SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE;
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sample_buffer[idx]), sizeof(SensorSample));
  }
  f.close();
  Serial.printf("[LOG] flushed %u samples to %s\n", (unsigned)sample_buffer_pending, SAMPLE_FILE_PATH);
  sample_buffer_pending = 0;
  last_flash_flush_ms = millis();
}

static void maybe_flush_sample_buffer() {
  unsigned long now = millis();
  if (sample_buffer_pending == 0) return;
  if (sample_buffer_pending >= FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD || now - last_flash_flush_ms >= FLASH_FLUSH_PERIOD_MS) {
    flush_sample_buffer_to_flash();
  }
}

static void persist_system_state_to_flash(const SensorData& data) {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
  doc["esp_start_ms"] = millis();
  if (rtc_ok && incubation_start_unix > 0) {
    doc["incubation_start_unix"] = incubation_start_unix;
  } else {
    doc["incubation_elapsed_base_ms"] = incubation_elapsed_base_ms;
  }

  JsonObject sensors = doc.createNestedObject("sensors");
  sensors["temp_chamber"] = data.temp[0];
  sensors["temp_chamber_valid"] = (data.temp[0] > -50.0f && data.temp[0] < 120.0f);
  sensors["temp_secondary"] = data.temp[1];
  sensors["temp_secondary_valid"] = (data.temp[1] > -50.0f && data.temp[1] < 120.0f);
  sensors["humidity"] = data.humidity;
  sensors["humidity_valid"] = (data.humidity >= 0.0f && data.humidity <= 100.0f);
  sensors["door_open"] = data.door_open;
  sensors["water_level"] = data.water_level;

  JsonArray trays = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
    JsonObject tray = trays.createNestedObject();
    tray["index"] = i;
    tray["active"] = st.active;
    tray["current_day"] = st.current_day;
    tray["days_remaining"] = st.days_remaining;
    tray["last_rotation_day"] = st.last_rotation_day;
    tray["last_rotation_hour"] = st.last_rotation_hour;
    tray["last_rotation_minute"] = st.last_rotation_minute;
    tray["last_rotation_elapsed_ms"] = st.last_rotation_elapsed_ms;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  File f = LittleFS.open(STATE_FILE_PATH, "w");
  if (f) {
    f.print(output);
    f.close();
    Serial.println("[STATE] state written to flash");
  } else {
    Serial.println("[STATE] failed to write state to flash");
  }
}

static void log_sample_if_changed(const SensorData& data) {
  SensorSample sample = make_sensor_sample(data);
  if (!has_last_sample || sample_is_significant(sample, last_sample)) {
    bool immediate = has_last_sample && sample_requires_immediate_flush(sample, last_sample);
    sample_buffer_append(sample);
    if (immediate) {
      flush_sample_buffer_to_flash();
    }
  }
}

}

static void flush_sample_buffer_to_flash() {
  if (sample_buffer_pending == 0) return;
  File f = LittleFS.open(SAMPLE_FILE_PATH, "a");
  if (!f) {
    Serial.println("[LOG] Failed to open sample file for flush");
    return;
  }

  size_t start = (sample_buffer_head + SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE - sample_buffer_pending) % SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < sample_buffer_pending; i++) {
    size_t idx = start + i;
    if (idx >= SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE) idx -= SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE;
    f.write(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sample_buffer[idx]), sizeof(SensorSample));
  }
  f.close();
  Serial.printf("[LOG] flushed %u samples to %s\n", (unsigned)sample_buffer_pending, SAMPLE_FILE_PATH);
  sample_buffer_pending = 0;
  last_flash_flush_ms = millis();
}

static void maybe_flush_sample_buffer() {
  unsigned long now = millis();
  if (sample_buffer_pending == 0) return;
  if (sample_buffer_pending >= FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD || now - last_flash_flush_ms >= FLASH_FLUSH_PERIOD_MS) {
    flush_sample_buffer_to_flash();
  }
}

static void persist_system_state_to_flash(const SensorData& data) {
  DynamicJsonDocument doc(4096);
  doc["esp_start_ms"] = millis();
  if (rtc_ok && incubation_start_unix > 0) {
    doc["incubation_start_unix"] = incubation_start_unix;
  } else {
    doc["incubation_elapsed_base_ms"] = incubation_elapsed_base_ms;
  }

  JsonObject sensors = doc.createNestedObject("sensors");
  sensors["temp_chamber"] = data.temp[0];
  sensors["temp_chamber_valid"] = (data.temp[0] > -50.0f && data.temp[0] < 120.0f);
  sensors["temp_secondary"] = data.temp[1];
  sensors["temp_secondary_valid"] = (data.temp[1] > -50.0f && data.temp[1] < 120.0f);
  sensors["humidity"] = data.humidity;
  sensors["humidity_valid"] = (data.humidity >= 0.0f && data.humidity <= 100.0f);
  sensors["door_open"] = data.door_open;
  sensors["water_level"] = data.water_level;

  JsonArray trays = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
    JsonObject tray = trays.createNestedObject();
    tray["index"] = i;
    tray["active"] = st.active;
    tray["current_day"] = st.current_day;
    tray["days_remaining"] = st.days_remaining;
    tray["last_rotation_day"] = st.last_rotation_day;
    tray["last_rotation_hour"] = st.last_rotation_hour;
    tray["last_rotation_minute"] = st.last_rotation_minute;
    tray["last_rotation_elapsed_ms"] = st.last_rotation_elapsed_ms;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  File f = LittleFS.open(STATE_FILE_PATH, "w");
  if (f) {
    f.print(output);
    f.close();
    Serial.println("[STATE] state written to flash");
  } else {
    Serial.println("[STATE] failed to write state to flash");
  }
}

static void log_sample_if_changed(const SensorData& data) {
  SensorSample sample = make_sensor_sample(data);
  if (!has_last_sample || sample_is_significant(sample, last_sample)) {
    bool immediate = has_last_sample && sample_requires_immediate_flush(sample, last_sample);
    sample_buffer_append(sample);
    if (immediate) {
      flush_sample_buffer_to_flash();
    }
  }
}

_**User (2026-06-14 20:39:37Z)**_

Widzę, że masz już konkretną koncepcję: bufor RAM na próbki sensorów (temp, wilgotność) z opóźnionym zapisem do flasha, ale **nie dla każdej próbki**, tylko gdy coś się zmieniło (temperatura o 0.1°C, wilgotność o 0.5%) lub po 24h, albo gdy bufor się zapełni. Dodatkowo chcesz zapisywać **stan urządzenia** (ostatni obrót tac, liczba obrotów, dzień inkubacji, tryby pracy) do osobnego pliku `state.json`.

Zasoby RAM: masz ~246 KB wolnego. Bufor 8192 próbek × 16 B = 131 KB. Zostaje ok. 115 KB na resztę – wystarczy.

## 🎯 Proponowana strategia

1. **Próbkowanie sensorów** co 10 s (lub 5 s w trybie testowym).
2. **Dodawanie próbki do bufora RAM tylko jeśli**:`temp_chamber` zmieniła się o ≥ `SAMPLE_TEMP_DELTA_THRESH` (0.1°C)
3. LUB `humidity` zmieniła się o ≥ `SAMPLE_HUM_DELTA_THRESH` (0.5%)
4. LUB od ostatniego zapisu do flasha minęło **24h** (wymuszenie zapisu okresowego)
5. LUB bufor `sample_buffer_pending` osiągnie `FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD` (np. 1000).
6. **Zapis do flasha**:Funkcja `flushToFlash()` dopisuje wszystkie oczekujące próbki do pliku binarnego.
7. Czyści `sample_buffer_pending = 0`, aktualizuje `last_flash_flush_ms`.
8. **Stan urządzenia** (parametry operacyjne) zapisujemy w osobnym pliku JSON:`last_rotation_time` dla każdej tacy,
9. `rotations_today`, `rotations_total`,
10. `current_day`, `species`,
11. `heater_pwm`, `diffuser_state`, tryby AUTO/MANUAL,
12. `lockdown_active` itp.
13. Zapisujemy do flasha przy każdej zmianie tych parametrów (nie czekamy 24h).

## 📝 Przykładowy kod w C++ (dla ESP32, z wykorzystaniem LittleFS i RTClib)
cpp

```
#include 
#include 
#include - #include 

// ---------- Definicje plików ----------
static const char SAMPLE_FILE_PATH[] = "/samples.bin";
static const char STATE_FILE_PATH[] = "/state.json";

// ---------- Parametry próbkowania ----------
static const unsigned long SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS_NORMAL = 10000; // 10 s
static const unsigned long SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS_TEST   = 5000;  // 5 s
static const float SAMPLE_TEMP_DELTA_THRESH = 0.1f;   // 0.1°C
static const float SAMPLE_HUM_DELTA_THRESH = 0.5f;    // 0.5% RH
static const unsigned long FLASH_FORCE_PERIOD_MS = 24UL * 3600UL * 1000UL; // 24h
static const size_t FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD = 1000;

// ---------- Bufor próbek (RAM) ----------
static const size_t SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE = 8192;
struct SensorSample {
  uint64_t timestamp_ms;
  int16_t temp_chamber_x10;
  int16_t temp_secondary_x10;
  int16_t humidity_x10;
  uint8_t flags;
  uint8_t reserved;
};
static SensorSample sample_buffer[SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE];
static size_t sample_buffer_head = 0;
static size_t sample_buffer_pending = 0;
static unsigned long last_flash_flush_ms = 0;
static bool has_last_sample = false;
static SensorSample last_sample = {};

// ---------- Stan urządzenia (przechowywany w RAM i JSON) ----------
struct DeviceState {
  uint32_t version = 1;
  uint64_t last_rotation_time_ms[2];   // dla dwóch tac
  uint32_t rotations_today[2];
  uint32_t rotations_total[2];
  uint8_t current_day[2];
  char species[2][16];
  uint16_t heater_pwm[4];
  bool heater_auto[4];
  bool diffuser_state[2];
  bool diffuser_auto;
  bool lockdown_active[2];
  // ... dodaj inne potrzebne pola
};

static DeviceState devState;
static bool state_changed = false; // flaga do zapisu stanu przy zmianie

// ---------- Inicjalizacja RTC i LittleFS ----------
void setupStorage() {
  if (!LittleFS.begin()) {
    Serial.println("LittleFS mount failed");
    return;
  }
  if (!rtc.begin()) {
    Serial.println("RTC not found");
  }
  loadDeviceState();   // wczytaj ostatni stan z JSON
}

// ---------- Pobranie timestampu (ms) ----------
uint64_t getTimestampMs() {
  if (rtc.isrunning()) {
    DateTime now = rtc.now();
    return (uint64_t)now.unixtime() * 1000ULL;
  } else {
    return millis(); // fallback
  }
}

// ---------- Dodanie próbki do bufora (tylko jeśli znacząca zmiana) ----------
bool shouldAddSample(float temp, float temp2, float hum) {
  if (!has_last_sample) return true; // pierwsza próbka zawsze
  float lastTemp = last_sample.temp_chamber_x10 / 10.0f;
  float lastHum  = last_sample.humidity_x10 / 10.0f;
  if (fabs(temp - lastTemp) >= SAMPLE_TEMP_DELTA_THRESH) return true;
  if (fabs(hum - lastHum)   >= SAMPLE_HUM_DELTA_THRESH) return true;
  // okresowy wymuszony zapis (co 24h)
  if (millis() - last_flash_flush_ms >= FLASH_FORCE_PERIOD_MS) return true;
  // bufer prawie pełny – lepiej dodać i wymusić zapis niż stracić dane
  if (sample_buffer_pending >= FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD - 10) return true;
  return false;
}

void addSample(float temp_chamber, float temp_secondary, float humidity) {
  if (!shouldAddSample(temp_chamber, temp_secondary, humidity)) return;
  
  SensorSample samp;
  samp.timestamp_ms = getTimestampMs();
  samp.temp_chamber_x10  = (int16_t)(temp_chamber * 10);
  samp.temp_secondary_x10 = (int16_t)(temp_secondary * 10);
  samp.humidity_x10 = (int16_t)(humidity * 10);
  samp.flags = 0;
  samp.reserved = 0;

  // zapisz do bufora kołowego
  sample_buffer[sample_buffer_head] = samp;
  sample_buffer_head = (sample_buffer_head + 1) % SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE;
  if (sample_buffer_pending = FLASH_FORCE_PERIOD_MS;
  bool countToFlush = sample_buffer_pending >= FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD;
  if (timeToFlush || countToFlush) {
    flushSamplesToFlash();
  }
}

// ---------- Zapis bufora próbek do pliku binarnego ----------
void flushSamplesToFlash() {
  if (sample_buffer_pending == 0) return;
  File file = LittleFS.open(SAMPLE_FILE_PATH, "a");
  if (!file) {
    Serial.println("Failed to open samples file for writing");
    return;
  }
  // Oblicz indeks najstarszej oczekującej próbki
  size_t startIdx;
  if (sample_buffer_pending = interval) {
    lastSensorReadMs = nowMs;
    float t1 = readTemperatureDS18B20(0);  // Twoja funkcja
    float t2 = readTemperatureDS18B20(1);
    float hum = readHumidityDHT11();
    addSample(t1, t2, hum);
  }
  
  // co jakiś czas (np. co 5s) zapisz stan, jeśli się zmienił
  static unsigned long lastStateSaveMs = 0;
  if (state_changed && (nowMs - lastStateSaveMs >= 5000)) {
    saveDeviceState();
    lastStateSaveMs = nowMs;
  }
  
  // ... reszta twojego kodu (sterowanie grzałkami, tacami, obsługa API)
}
```

## 📌 Kluczowe cechy tego rozwiązania
**Oszczędność RAM** – do bufora trafiają tylko próbki ze zmianą (typowo kilka na godzinę).
- **Rzadki zapis do flasha** – bufor w RAM gromadzi zmiany, flash zapisywany co 1000 próbek lub co 24h.
- **Stan urządzenia** – osobny plik JSON, zapisywany przy każdej zmianie (z buforowaniem, żeby nie zapisywać zbyt często).
- **Łatwy odczyt** – plik binarny można później przesłać przez HTTP i wyświetlić na wykresie.

## 🔁 Synchronizacja z panelem internetowym
Panel (HTML/JS) może:

- Pobrać `/api/samples?since=timestamp` – zwrócić próbki od podanego czasu.
- Pobrać `/api/state` – aktualny stan urządzenia (JSON).
- Wysłać komendy zmieniające stan (np. obrót tacy, dzień, tryb) – wtedy w ESP ustawiasz `state_changed = true` i po chwili zapisujesz do flasha.

static void persist_system_state_if_needed(const SensorData& data) {
  if (!state_dirty) return;
  unsigned long now = millis();
  if (last_state_write_ms != 0 && now - last_state_write_ms < STATE_SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS) return;
  persist_system_state_to_flash(data);
  state_dirty = false;
  last_state_write_ms = now;
}

## Analiza buforowania danych i zapisu do flasha
Twój obecny kod **już implementuje optymalną strategię** – buforujesz tylko istotne zmiany i zapisujesz je rzadko. Poniżej szczegółowa ocena oraz ewentualne drobne optymalizacje.

### 📦 Zużycie RAM

KomponentRozmiarUwagi`sample_buffer[8192]`8192 × 16 B = **131 072 B** (~128 KB)Bufor próbekPozostałe zmienne globalneok. 30–40 KBSterowniki, stan tac, WiFi, JSON itp.Stos, sterta, bibliotekireszta
**Wolne RAM:** 246 KB (z `ESP.getFreeHeap()`) – po odjęciu bufora (~128 KB) zostaje ok. **118 KB** na resztę. To bezpieczny margines.

> 💡 Jeśli chcesz jeszcze więcej wolnego RAM (np. dla przyszłych funkcji), możesz zmniejszyć `SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE` do **4096** (64 KB) – to wciąż pojemność ~2 dni przy próbkowaniu co 10 s i zapisie tylko zmian.

### 🧠 Strategia buforowania i zapisu – już masz dobrze!
Twój kod robi dokładnie to, co sugerujesz:

1. **Buforujesz tylko zmiany**
`sample_is_significant()` dodaje próbkę tylko gdy:Temperatura zmieniła się ≥ **0.1°C**
2. Wilgotność zmieniła się ≥ **0.5%**
Dzięki temu przy stabilnej pracy dodajesz kilka próbek na godzinę, a nie 360 (co 10 sekund).3. **Zapis do flasha odbywa się rzadko**Co **24 godziny** (`FLASH_FLUSH_PERIOD_MS = 24*3600*1000`)
4. Lub gdy uzbiera się **1000 próbek** w buforze
5. Lub natychmiast przy gwałtownej zmianie (`>0.5°C` lub `>1%` wilg.) – to zabezpieczenie przed utratą krytycznego zdarzenia.
6. **Stan systemu (tace, dzień, konfiguracja) zapisywany jest tylko przy zmianie**
`state_dirty` + debounce 5 sekund – nie ma ciągłego zapisu.

### 📊 Przykład działania
Załóżmy stabilną inkubację (zmiany temperatury <0.1°C przez godzinę):

- W ciągu godziny dodasz **0–2 próbki** (np. przy lekkim wahnięciu wilgotności).
- Bufor 8192 próbek wystarczy na **ponad 4000 godzin** (ponad 160 dni) stabilnej pracy.
- Zapis do flasha nastąpi **co 24h** (i tak bufor nie będzie pełny).

### ⚠️ Drobne uwagi do kodu (opcjonalne)

1. **Funkcja `sample_timestamp_ms()`** – jeśli brak RTC, zwraca `data.elapsed_ms` (millisy od startu). To jest OK, ale przy restarcie ESP stracisz absolutny czas zdarzeń. Rozważ zapisywanie `millis()` razem z `RTC` offsetem, ale nie jest to krytyczne.
2. **`FLASH_FLUSH_PERIOD_MS`** – ustawione na 24h. Jeśli bufor ma 8192 próbki, a dodajesz średnio 10 próbek na godzinę, to zapis nastąpi po ~800 godzinach (33 dni). Możesz zmniejszyć do **12 godzin** dla bezpieczeństwa, ale nie trzeba.
3. **Zapis `state.json`** – robisz to tylko gdy `state_dirty`. Świetnie. Możesz dodać wymuszenie zapisu co 24h na wypadek, gdyby `state_dirty` nie został ustawiony przez długi czas (np. przez błąd). Ale to już detal.

### 🧪 Czy RAM wystarczy na dłuższe buforowanie?

- Przy obecnym buforze 8192 próbek i próbkowaniu co 10 s, teoretyczny maksymalny czas wypełnienia (gdyby każda próbka była dodawana) to:
`8192 * 10 s = 81920 s ≈ 22.7 godziny`.
- Jednak dzięki **filtrowaniu zmian** w praktyce wypełnienie bufora zajmie **znacznie dłużej** (nawet tygodnie).
- Jeśli chcesz mieć zapas, możesz zwiększyć `SAMPLE_BUFFER_SIZE` do 16384 (262 KB RAM) – ale wtedy zużyjesz prawie cały wolny RAM (246 KB), co może być ryzykowne dla innych funkcji (np. obsługa żądań HTTP z dużymi JSON). Polecam zostać przy 8192.

### 🎯 Ostateczna rekomendacja
**Twój kod jest już doskonały.** Nie musisz nic zmieniać – spełnia wszystkie założenia:

- Buforuje tylko zmiany (oszczędność RAM i flasha)
- Zapisuje rzadko (24h lub 1000 próbek)
- Natychmiastowe zapisy przy krytycznych zdarzeniach
- Stan systemu zapisywany tylko przy modyfikacji

Jeśli jednak chcesz jeszcze bardziej ograniczyć zapisy do flasha (przedłużyć jego żywotność), możesz:

- Zwiększyć `FLASH_FLUSH_SAMPLE_THRESHOLD` do **2000** lub **5000**.
- Zmniejszyć `FLASH_FLUSH_PERIOD_MS` do **48 godzin** (ale wtedy przy restarcie możesz stracić więcej danych).

Pamiętaj, że flash ESP32 ma typowo **100 000 cykli zapisu na sektor**. Przy zapisie co 24h i buforze 1000 próbek, zapisujesz ~1 raz dziennie → **ponad 270 lat teoretycznej żywotności** – więc spokojnie.

### 🤖 Logika rozmyta dla grzałek
Twój obecny regulator to **hybryda PI z rampą startową i członem pochodnym** – działa dobrze, ale nie jest w pełni rozmyty. Jeśli chcesz go zastąpić kodem fuzzy, który podałem wcześniej, możesz to zrobić, ale nie jest to konieczne. Obecny kod jest prostszy i szybszy obliczeniowo, co na ESP32 ma znaczenie.

Jeśli potrzebujesz pomocy w integracji logiki rozmytej lub dalszej optymalizacji bufora – daj znać! Jeśli chcesz, mogę teraz dodać jeszcze `GET /api/state` lub usunąć już nieużywany log CSV z kodu.

  JsonObject sensors = doc.createNestedObject("sensors");
  sensors["temp_chamber"] = data.temp[0];
  sensors["temp_chamber_valid"] = (data.temp[0] > -50.0f && data.temp[0] < 120.0f);
  sensors["temp_secondary"] = data.temp[1];
  sensors["temp_secondary_valid"] = (data.temp[1] > -50.0f && data.temp[1] < 120.0f);
  sensors["humidity"] = data.humidity;
  sensors["humidity_valid"] = (data.humidity >= 0.0f && data.humidity <= 100.0f);
  sensors["door_open"] = data.door_open;
  sensors["water_level"] = data.water_level;

  JsonArray trays = doc.createNestedArray("trays");
  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_TRAYS; i++) {
    TrayState& st = tray_states[i];
    JsonObject tray = trays.createNestedObject();
    tray["index"] = i;
    tray["active"] = st.active;
    tray["current_day"] = st.current_day;
    tray["days_remaining"] = st.days_remaining;
    tray["last_rotation_day"] = st.last_rotation_day;
    tray["last_rotation_hour"] = st.last_rotation_hour;
    tray["last_rotation_minute"] = st.last_rotation_minute;
    tray["last_rotation_elapsed_ms"] = st.last_rotation_elapsed_ms;
  }

  String output;
  serializeJson(doc, output);
  File f = LittleFS.open(STATE_FILE_PATH, "w");
  if (f) {
    f.print(output);
    f.close();
    Serial.println("[STATE] state written to flash");
  } else {
    Serial.println("[STATE] failed to write state to flash");
  }
}

Na podstawie tych danych można wyliczyć współczynnik przenikania ciepła (U / lambda) oraz szybkość ucieczki wilgoci, co pomoże dobrać akumulatory do zasilania awaryjnego.

Przygotuję dla Ciebie **dodatek do istniejącego HTML/JS** – nową sekcję w zakładce kalibracji, która:

1. Uruchamia test "OFF ALL" (wyłącza grzałki, dyfuzory, wentylator – przez API lub symulację).
2. Zbiera dane temperatury i wilgotności w czasie (co 5–10 sekund).
3. Po zakończeniu testu oblicza:Szybkość spadku temperatury [°C/h] (nachylenie regresji liniowej).

5. Szacowany współczynnik strat ciepła (U) [W/K] – jeśli znasz pojemność cieplną komory (można podać w GUI).

  🌡️ Analiza strat ciepła i wilgotności (OFF ALL)

  
    Test polega na wyłączeniu grzałek i dyfuzorów oraz rejestracji spadku temperatury i wilgotności w zamkniętej komorze.
    Wyniki pozwolą oszacować współczynnik strat ciepła i dobrać akumulatory.
  

  
    
      Pojemność cieplna komory (kJ/K)
      
      Wartość typowa: 8–15 kJ/K dla inkubatora 60l

    

    
      Czas pomiaru (min)
      
      Test może trwać od 5 do 180 minut

    

  

  
    ▶ Rozpocznij test OFF ALL
    ■ Zatrzymaj test
    📎 Eksport CSV
  

  — Test nieaktywny —

  
  

  
  
    Wyniki analizy strat

// MODUŁ ANALIZY STRAT CIEPŁA I WILGOTNOŚCI (OFF ALL)

let thermalTestActive = false;

const resultsContent = document.getElementById('results-content');
const thermalCanvas = document.getElementById('thermal-chart');
let chartCtx = null;

// Inicjalizacja canvas (rozmiar)
function initChart() {
  if (!thermalCanvas) return;
  thermalCanvas.width = thermalCanvas.clientWidth;
  thermalCanvas.height = thermalCanvas.clientHeight;
  chartCtx = thermalCanvas.getContext('2d');
}

// Rysuj wykres
function drawThermalChart() {
  if (!chartCtx || thermalData.length === 0) return;
  const w = thermalCanvas.width, h = thermalCanvas.height;
  chartCtx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
  
  // Znajdź zakresy
  let minTemp = 100, maxTemp = -100, minHum = 100, maxHum = -100;
  for (let d of thermalData) {
    if (d.temp  maxTemp) maxTemp = d.temp;
    if (d.hum  maxHum) maxHum = d.hum;
  }
  if (minTemp === maxTemp) { minTemp -= 1; maxTemp += 1; }
  if (minHum === maxHum) { minHum -= 5; maxHum += 5; }
  
  const pad = 40;
  const plotW = w - 2*pad;
  const plotH = h - 2*pad;
  const mapX = (idx) => pad + (idx / (thermalData.length-1)) * plotW;
  const mapY_temp = (val) => pad + plotH - ((val - minTemp) / (maxTemp - minTemp)) * plotH;
  const mapY_hum = (val) => pad + plotH - ((val - minHum) / (maxHum - minHum)) * plotH;
  
  // Tło
  chartCtx.fillStyle = '#111c11';
  chartCtx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
  
  // Siatka
  chartCtx.strokeStyle = '#2f5a3a';
  chartCtx.lineWidth = 0.5;
  for (let i=0;iconsole.warn);
  }
  // Wyłączenie dyfuzorów
  await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?on=0', {method:'POST'}).catch(e=>console.warn);
  // Opcjonalnie: wentylator – jeśli ma osobny endpoint, dodaj.
  // Możesz też dodać wyłączenie tac (choć one nie grzeją)
  for (let i=0;iconsole.warn);
  }
  // Ustaw tryb ręczny dla dyfuzorów, żeby nie włączyły się automatycznie
  await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?auto=0&on=0', {method:'POST'}).catch(e=>console.warn);
}

// Włączenie automatycznego sterowania (przywrócenie)
async function allAuto() {
  for (let ch=0; chconsole.warn);
  }
  await fetch('/api/diffuser/set?auto=1', {method:'POST'}).catch(e=>console.warn);
  for (let i=0;iconsole.warn);
  }
}

// Rozpoczęcie testu
async function startThermalTest() {
  if (thermalTestActive) {
    alert('Test już trwa!');
    return;
  }
  const durationMin = parseInt(document.getElementById('test-duration-min').value);
  if (isNaN(durationMin) || durationMin =5)');
    return;
  }
  if (!confirm(`Rozpoczęcie testu OFF ALL na ${durationMin} minut.\nWszystkie grzałki i dyfuzory zostaną wyłączone.\nCzy kontynuować?`)) return;
  
  // Wyczyść poprzednie dane
  thermalData = [];
  testStartTime = Date.now();
  testDurationSec = durationMin * 60;
  thermalTestActive = true;
  
  // Wyłącz urządzenia
  await allOff();
  
  // Pobierz pierwszy odczyt
  const initial = await fetchCurrentStatus();
  if (initial) {
    thermalData.push({ timestamp: testStartTime, temp: initial.temp, hum: initial.hum });
  }
  
  // UI
  startBtn.disabled = true;
  stopBtn.disabled = false;
  exportBtn.disabled = true;
  resultsDiv.style.display = 'none';
  progressDiv.innerHTML = `⏳ Test rozpoczęty. Zbieranie danych przez ${durationMin} min...`;
  
  // Rozpocznij interwał odczytu (co 10 sekund)
  if (thermalTestInterval) clearInterval(thermalTestInterval);
  thermalTestInterval = setInterval(async () => {
    if (!thermalTestActive) return;
    const now = Date.now();
    const elapsedSec = (now - testStartTime) / 1000;
    const remainingSec = testDurationSec - elapsedSec;
    progressDiv.innerHTML = `⏳ Trwa test... pozostało ${Math.ceil(remainingSec/60)} min (${Math.ceil(remainingSec)} s). Zebrano ${thermalData.length} próbek.`;
    
    if (elapsedSec >= testDurationSec) {
      // Zakończ test automatycznie
      await stopThermalTest(false);
      return;
    }
    
    const status = await fetchCurrentStatus();
    if (status && status.temp !== undefined) {
      thermalData.push({ timestamp: now, temp: status.temp, hum: status.hum });
      drawThermalChart();
      // Opcjonalnie: aktualizuj wstępne wyniki na żywo
      updateLiveResults();
    }
  }, 10000); // co 10 sekund
}

async function stopThermalTest(userStopped) {
  if (!thermalTestActive && !userStopped) return;

    clearInterval(thermalTestInterval);

                         Straty ciepła (U·A):${watts.toFixed(0)} W/°C

                         Szacowany czas podtrzymania ΔT=1°C z baterii 100Wh:${hoursOnBattery.toFixed(1)} h

`;
    resultsContent.innerHTML = resultsHtml;
    resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    resultsContent.innerHTML = 'Za mało danych do analizy.

    resultsDiv.style.display = 'block';
  }
  
  startBtn.disabled = false;
  stopBtn.disabled = true;
  exportBtn.disabled = false;
  progressDiv.innerHTML = userStopped ? '✓ Test przerwany przez użytkownika.' : '✓ Test zakończony. Wyniki powyżej.';
}

function exportThermalTestCSV() {
  if (thermalData.length === 0) {
    alert('Brak danych do eksportu.');
    return;
  }
  let csv = "timestamp_sec,temperature_C,humidity_pct\n";
  const start = testStartTime || thermalData[0].timestamp;
  for (let d of thermalData) {
    let t = (d.timestamp - start) / 1000;
    csv += `${t},${d.temp.toFixed(2)},${d.hum.toFixed(2)}\n`;
  }
  const blob = new Blob([csv], {type: 'text/csv'});
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  link.download = `thermal_test_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,19)}.csv`;
  link.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
}

// Inicjalizacja wykresu przy ładowaniu strony
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initChart();
  // Nasłuchuj zmiany rozmiaru okna, aby przeskalować canvas
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    if (thermalCanvas) {
      thermalCanvas.width = thermalCanvas.clientWidth;
      thermalCanvas.height = thermalCanvas.clientHeight;
      drawThermalChart();
    }
  });
});

### Objaśnienie

1. **Test OFF ALL** – wywołuje API do wyłączenia grzałek, dyfuzorów i tac (opcjonalnie). Następnie co 10 sekund pobiera dane z `/api/status`.
2. **Wizualizacja** – na bieżąco rysuje wykres temperatury i wilgotności w czasie.
3. **Obliczenia** – po zakończeniu testu (lub na żywo podczas trwania) liczy nachylenie linii trendu (regresja liniowa) dla temperatury i wilgotności, co daje szybkość spadku w °C/h i %/h.
4. **Straty ciepła** – na podstawie podanej przez użytkownika pojemności cieplnej komory (kJ/K) oblicza stratę mocy w watach na każdy stopień różnicy między wnętrzem a otoczeniem. Umożliwia to oszacowanie, jak duży akumulator potrzeba do utrzymania temperatury przez określony czas.
5. **Eksport CSV** – pozwala zapisać surowe dane do analizy w arkuszu kalkulacyjnym.

**Uwaga**: Aby test był wiarygodny, komora musi być zamknięta, a warunki początkowe stabilne (ustalona temperatura i wilgotność). Przed rozpoczęciem upewnij się, że drzwi są zamknięte, a wentylator (jeśli sterowany) również wyłączony – możesz dodać odpowiednie API.

Jeśli potrzebujesz dodać czujnik temperatury zewnętrznej – wystarczy rozszerzyć `/api/status` o pole `ambient_temp`, a w kodzie testu uwzględnić różnicę temperatur dla dokładniejszego wyznaczania współczynnika U. Możesz też dodać pole do ręcznego wprowadzenia temperatury otoczenia w GUI.

] map[filePath:J:\inkubator\index.html newString:function kalUpdateDecayCalculations(){
  const samples = KAL.decaySamples.length;
  const box = document.getElementById('kal-decay-box');
  if(box) box.style.display = samples ? '' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-duration').textContent = samples ? Math.round((Date.now()-KAL.decayStartTs)/1000)+' s' : '0 s';
  const ambientTemp = parseFloat(document.getElementById('kal-decay-ambient-temp')?.value);
  const ambientHum = parseFloat(document.getElementById('kal-decay-ambient-hum')?.value);
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-start').textContent = samples ? (KAL.decaySamples[0].temp.toFixed(1)+' °C') : '-- °C';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-end').textContent = samples ? (KAL.decaySamples[samples-1].temp.toFixed(1)+' °C') : '-- °C';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-start').textContent = samples ? (KAL.decaySamples[0].hum.toFixed(1)+' %') : '-- %';
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-end').textContent = samples ? (KAL.decaySamples[samples-1].hum.toFixed(1)+' %') : '-- %';
  if(samples >= 2){
    const first = KAL.decaySamples[0];
    const last = KAL.decaySamples[samples-1];
    const dt = (last.ts - first.ts) / 3600000;
    const dTemp = last.temp - first.temp;
    const dHum = last.hum - first.hum;
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-delta').textContent = (dTemp >= 0 ? '+' : '') + dTemp.toFixed(2) + ' °C';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-delta').textContent = (dHum >= 0 ? '+' : '') + dHum.toFixed(2) + ' %';
    if(dt > 0){
      const slopeTemp = kalComputeDecaySlope(KAL.decaySamples, 'temp');
      const slopeHum = kalComputeDecaySlope(KAL.decaySamples, 'hum');
      document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-rate').textContent = (slopeTemp !== null ? slopeTemp : dTemp / dt).toFixed(2) + ' °C/h';
      document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-rate').textContent = (slopeHum !== null ? slopeHum : dHum / dt).toFixed(2) + ' %/h';
    } else {
      document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-rate').textContent = '-- °C/h';
      document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-rate').textContent = '-- %/h';
    }
  } else {
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-delta').textContent = '-- °C';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-delta').textContent = '-- %';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-temp-rate').textContent = '-- °C/h';
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-hum-rate').textContent = '-- %/h';
  }
  if(Number.isFinite(ambientTemp)){
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-ambient-temp').value = ambientTemp.toFixed(1);
  }
  if(Number.isFinite(ambientHum)){
    document.getElementById('kal-decay-ambient-hum').value = ambientHum.toFixed(1);
  }
  document.getElementById('kal-decay-samples').textContent = samples;
}

function kalComputeDecaySlope(samples, key){
  if(samples.length < 2) return null;
  const t0 = samples[0].ts;
  let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, sumXY = 0, sumXX = 0;
  const n = samples.length;
  for(const s of samples){
    const x = s.ts - t0;
    const y = s[key];
    sumX += x;
    sumY += y;
    sumXY += x * y;
    sumXX += x * x;
  }
  const denom = n * sumXX - sumX * sumX;
  return denom === 0 ? null : ((n * sumXY - sumX * sumY) / denom) * 3600000;
}

  .topbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,auto) 1fr minmax(0,auto);align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 22px;min-height:56px;background:rgba(11,20,11,.96);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,58,37,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}

  .topbar-stat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);white-space:nowrap}

  .topbar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--muted)} .dot.ok{background:var(--green)} .dot.warn{background:var(--yellow)} .dot.err{background:var(--hot)}
  .badge{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;letter-spacing:.04em;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
  .badge-info{background:rgba(79,156,249,.14);color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(79,156,249,.25)}
  .badge-warn{background:rgba(234,179,8,.15);color:var(--yellow);border:1px solid rgba(234,179,8,.25)}
  .badge-hot{background:rgba(239,68,68,.15);color:var(--hot);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.25)}
  .badge-ok{background:rgba(34,197,94,.15);color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25)}
  .badge-lock{background:rgba(124,106,247,.15);color:var(--accent2);border:1px solid rgba(124,106,247,.25)}
  .tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:10px 20px 0;background:rgba(11,20,11,.95);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,58,37,.8);flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
  .tab{padding:8px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);border:none;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);cursor:pointer;border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;transition:all .15s ease}
  .tab:hover{color:var(--text);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .tab.active{color:var(--accent);background:rgba(57,211,95,.08);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent)}
  .main{padding:16px 20px;max-width:1280px;margin:0 auto}
  .grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px} .grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px} .grid-auto{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:12px}
  @media(max-width:900px){.grid-2,.grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .section-label{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin:18px 0 8px}
  .card{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px}
  .card.alarm{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.5)}
  .card-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px}
  .card-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
  .metric-big{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:38px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;color:var(--text)} .metric-big.hot{color:var(--hot)} .metric-big.warn{color:var(--yellow)} .metric-big.ok{color:var(--green)} .metric-unit{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:2px}
  .metric-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .gauge-wrap{margin:8px 0 2px} .gauge-track{width:100%;height:6px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:3px;overflow:visible;position:relative} .gauge-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .4s ease}
  .gauge-fill.heater{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--warm),var(--hot))} .gauge-fill.humidity{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--cool),var(--accent))} .gauge-fill.memory{background:var(--accent2)}
  .gauge-marker{position:absolute;top:-5px;width:3px;height:16px;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--accent);z-index:2;border-radius:2px;transform:translateX(-50%)}
  .gauge-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}
  .tray-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)} .tray-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0}
  .tray-indicator{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border2);flex-shrink:0;position:relative}
  .tray-indicator.on{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--green)}
  .tray-indicator.moving{background:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--yellow)}
  .tray-indicator.moving::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-4px;border:2px solid rgba(234,179,8,.2);border-top-color:var(--yellow);border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
  .tray-info{flex:1;min-width:0} .tray-name{font-weight:500;font-size:12px} .tray-detail{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)} .tray-status-text{font-size:11px;font-weight:500} .tray-status-text.on{color:var(--green)} .tray-status-text.off{color:var(--muted)}
  .diffuser-visual{margin:14px 0 10px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
  .diffuser-icon{position:relative;width:40px;height:40px}
  .diffuser-icon span{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:0;transform:translateX(-50%);width:10px;height:20px;background:rgba(57,211,95,.18);border-radius:999px;opacity:0;animation:steam 2s infinite ease-in;filter:blur(1px)}
  .diffuser-icon span:nth-child(2){left:35%;width:8px;height:18px;animation-delay:.3s}

  .diffuser-visual.on .diffuser-icon span:nth-child(2){animation-duration:2.2s}
  .diffuser-visual.on .diffuser-icon span:nth-child(3){animation-duration:2.3s}
  @keyframes steam{0%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1);opacity:0}20%{opacity:.4}60%{transform:translateX(-40%) translateY(-24px) scale(1.1);opacity:.25}100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-48px) scale(1.2);opacity:0}}

  .hatch-status{margin-top:10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:rgba(30,33,48,.45)}
  .hatch-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--text);text-transform:uppercase}
  .hatch-dayline{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
  .hatch-timers{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:7px}
  .timer-chip{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--border2)}
  .timer-chip.up{color:var(--accent);background:rgba(79,156,249,.12)}
  .timer-chip.down{color:var(--yellow);background:rgba(234,179,8,.12)}
  .mini-live{margin-top:7px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
  .mini-live strong{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--text);font-size:13px}
  .power-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:9px 0 2px}
  .power-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
  .pip-switch{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
  .pip-switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
  .pip-slider{position:relative;width:58px;height:26px;border:1px solid var(--border2);border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#222637,#171a23);transition:all .2s ease}
  .pip-slider::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#76809c;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25),0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35);transition:all .2s ease}
  .pip-switch input:checked + .pip-slider{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(34,197,94,.32),rgba(34,197,94,.16));border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.5)}
  .pip-switch input:checked + .pip-slider::before{left:34px;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(34,197,94,.65)}
  .pip-text{display:flex;gap:6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .pip-text b{color:var(--green);font-weight:500}
  .pip-text i{color:var(--muted);font-style:normal}
  .card.power-off{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.45)}
  .card.power-off .metric-big{color:var(--muted)}
  .device-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border2);display:inline-block;margin-right:6px}
  .device-dot.on{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--green)}
  .control-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:8px 0} .control-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);min-width:80px;flex-shrink:0} .slider-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text);min-width:38px;text-align:right}
  .power-vu{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .power-vu-meter{width:100%;height:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
  .power-vu-fill{height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),var(--yellow),var(--hot));transition:width .2s ease}
  .power-vu-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
  .power-vu-label span:last-child{font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
  .pip-osc-section{margin-bottom:18px}
  .pip-osc-card{padding:14px;background:rgba(7,12,7,.96);border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.14);border-radius:16px}
  .pip-osc-card .card-header{margin-bottom:12px}
  .pip-osc-card .card-title{margin-bottom:4px}
  .pip-osc-canvas{width:100%;height:170px;display:block;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);margin-top:10px}
  .pip-osc-legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
  .pip-osc-key{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .pip-osc-key span{display:inline-block;border-radius:2px}
  .pip-osc-key .line-actual{width:20px;height:2px;background:#111}
  .pip-osc-key .line-target{width:20px;height:2px;background:#fff}
  .pip-osc-key .band-range{width:20px;height:10px;background:rgba(34,197,94,.35);border-radius:3px}
  input[type=range]{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;flex:1;height:4px;background:var(--bg3);border-radius:2px;outline:none} input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--bg2)}
  input[type=number], select{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;font-family:var(--font);font-size:13px;width:100%} input[type=number]:focus, select:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent)}
  .btn{padding:8px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border2);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s ease,opacity .15s ease,background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease;font-family:var(--font)} .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08)} .btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
  .btn-primary{background:rgba(79,156,249,.18);color:var(--accent);border-color:rgba(79,156,249,.35)} .btn-danger{background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);color:var(--hot);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.35)} .btn-success{background:rgba(34,197,94,.16);color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.35)} .btn-ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);color:var(--muted);border-color:var(--border)}
  .btn-full{width:100%} .btn-group{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .status-msg{font-size:11px;font-family:var(--mono);margin-top:6px;min-height:34px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.05)} .status-msg.ok{color:var(--green);background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.15)} .status-msg.err{color:var(--hot);background:rgba(239,68,68,.1);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.2)} .status-msg.info{color:var(--accent);background:rgba(79,156,249,.1);border-color:rgba(79,156,249,.2)}
  .mode-pill{padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;font-family:var(--mono)} .mode-pill.auto{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:var(--green)} .mode-pill.manual{background:rgba(234,179,8,.12);color:var(--yellow)}
  .sched-table,.wire-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12px} .sched-table th,.wire-table th{text-align:left;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding:6px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)} .sched-table td,.wire-table td{padding:7px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(42,46,64,.5);color:var(--text);vertical-align:middle} .sched-table tr.today td{background:rgba(79,156,249,.08)} .sched-table tr.lockdown td{background:rgba(124,106,247,.06)} .sched-table tr.conflict-green td{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08)} .sched-table tr.conflict-yellow td{background:rgba(234,179,8,.08)} .sched-table tr.conflict-red td{background:rgba(239,68,68,.08)} .lock-badge{font-size:9px;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(124,106,247,.2);color:var(--accent2);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.05em} .conflict-badge{display:inline-block;padding:2px 5px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700} .conflict-green{background:rgba(34,197,94,.12);color:var(--green)} .conflict-yellow{background:rgba(234,179,8,.14);color:var(--yellow)} .conflict-red{background:rgba(239,68,68,.14);color:var(--hot)}
  .view{display:none}.view.active{display:block}.divider{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:14px 0}.countdown-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;color:var(--text)} .countdown-val.soon{color:var(--yellow)}
  .wire-section{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);padding:10px 10px 4px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--bg3)} .wire-table code{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--accent);padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px}
  .esp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:12px} .esp-row:last-child{border-bottom:none} .esp-key{color:var(--muted)} .esp-val{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--text)} .esp-val.warn{color:var(--yellow)} .esp-val.danger{color:var(--hot)}
  .gauge-section{transition:opacity .2s,max-height .3s;overflow:hidden}
  .gauge-section.hidden{opacity:0;max-height:0;pointer-events:none}
  .chart-card{padding:12px 12px 10px}
  .chart-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .chart-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
  .chart-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .chart-tab{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--mono)}
  .chart-tab.active{border-color:rgba(79,156,249,.45);color:var(--accent);background:rgba(79,156,249,.14)}
  .chart-split{display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto auto;gap:10px}
  .chart-pane{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:8px}
  .chart-pane.main{min-height:220px}
  .chart-pane.detail{min-height:120px}
  .chart-caption{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);margin-bottom:6px;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
  .history-canvas{width:100%;display:block}
  .history-canvas.main{height:170px}
  .history-canvas.detail{height:86px}
  .chart-legend{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
  .legend-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
  .legend-line{width:18px;height:2px;border-radius:2px}
  .legend-band{width:18px;height:8px;border-radius:2px}
  .journal-list{display:grid;gap:8px}
  .journal-entry{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px}
  .journal-entry h4{font-size:12px;margin-bottom:4px}
  .journal-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .journal-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--text);margin-top:6px;white-space:pre-wrap}
  .journal-empty{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:12px 0}
  .tiny{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
  .stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:10px}
  .stat-tile{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:10px}
  .stat-label{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
  .stat-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:22px;line-height:1.1;margin-top:4px}
  #alerts-box{min-height:70px;padding:14px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(239,68,68,.08);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.22);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.02);font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
  .tray-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:3px 8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}
  .tray-chip.lockdown{border-color:rgba(124,106,247,.5);background:rgba(124,106,247,.10)}
  .tray-chip.hatch{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.5);background:rgba(34,197,94,.08)}
  .tray-chip-label{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
  .tray-chip-day{color:var(--text);font-weight:500}
  .tray-chip-sep{color:var(--border2)}
  .tray-chip-remain{font-size:10px;color:var(--green)}
  .tray-chip-remain.soon{color:var(--yellow)}
  .tray-chip-remain.lock{color:var(--accent2)}
  .log-list{display:grid;gap:2px;max-height:62vh;overflow-y:auto}
  @media(max-width:480px){
    .metric-big{font-size:28px}
    .topbar{gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;height:auto;grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .topbar-left,.topbar-center,.topbar-right{justify-content:flex-start}
    .topbar-stat{font-size:11px}
    .main{padding:10px 12px}
    .chart-pane.main{min-height:160px}
    .chart-pane.detail{min-height:90px}
    .history-canvas.main{height:130px}
    .history-canvas.detail{height:72px}
    .btn{padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px}
    .section-label{margin:12px 0 6px}
  }
  .log-entry{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid transparent}
  .log-entry.warn{border-color:rgba(234,179,8,.2);background:rgba(234,179,8,.04)}
  .log-entry.err{border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.22);background:rgba(239,68,68,.05)}
  .log-entry.ok{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.18);background:rgba(34,197,94,.03)}
  .log-entry.cmd{border-color:rgba(124,106,247,.18);background:rgba(124,106,247,.03)}
  .log-entry.lockdown{border-color:rgba(124,106,247,.35);background:rgba(124,106,247,.08);color:var(--accent2);font-weight:500}
  .log-entry.info{border-color:rgba(79,156,249,.15)}
  .log-ts{color:var(--muted);flex-shrink:0;font-size:10px;padding-top:1px}
  .log-msg{color:var(--text);flex:1;word-break:break-all}
  .btn-lockdown{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(239,68,68,.22),rgba(239,68,68,.16));color:var(--hot);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.5);font-size:13px;padding:12px 18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(239,68,68,.16);transition:transform .15s ease,background .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
  .btn-lockdown:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(239,68,68,.28),rgba(239,68,68,.2));transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(239,68,68,.2)}
  .btn-lockdown:active{transform:translateY(0);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(239,68,68,.17)}
  /* ===== PIP-BOY DASHBOARD ===== */
  .pip-header{display:flex;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:flex-end;padding:6px 0 14px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.18);margin-bottom:14px}
  .pip-logo{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#39d35f;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(57,211,95,.5)}
  .pip-logo-sub{display:none}
  .pip-clock{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:20px;color:rgba(57,211,95,.65);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(57,211,95,.35);letter-spacing:.08em}
  .pip-row-big{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr 0.95fr 0.75fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
  @media(max-width:1100px){.pip-row-big{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media(max-width:550px){.pip-row-big{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .pip-gauge-card{background:rgba(6,11,6,.99);border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.14);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 8px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:210px}
  .pip-gauge-card:first-child{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.4);box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(57,211,95,.08)}
  .pip-gauge-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 3px,rgba(57,211,95,.013) 3px,rgba(57,211,95,.013) 4px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
  .pip-canvas{width:100%;max-width:260px;display:block;position:relative;z-index:1}
  .pip-gauge-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:rgba(57,211,95,.6);text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:6px;text-align:center;text-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(57,211,95,.25);z-index:1}
  .pip-gauge-subvals{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
  .pip-gauge-subvals span{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
  .pip-tray-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr auto;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;align-items:start;min-width:0}
  @media(max-width:700px){.pip-tray-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media(max-width:500px){.pip-tray-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .status-tray-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 320px;gap:14px}
  .status-tray-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;align-items:start;min-width:0}
  @media(max-width:950px){.status-tray-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .status-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;color:rgba(57,211,95,.6)}
  .pip-offset-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px}
  @media(max-width:1000px){.pip-offset-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(180px,1fr))}}
  @media(max-width:650px){.pip-offset-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .pip-indicator-card{background:rgba(6,11,6,.96);border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.14);border-radius:12px;padding:14px;min-height:160px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
  .pip-indicator-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(57,211,95,.8);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:10px}
  .pip-indicator-value{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);line-height:1.1;margin-bottom:12px}
  .pip-indicator-value.hot{color:var(--hot)} .pip-indicator-value.warn{color:var(--yellow)} .pip-indicator-value.ok{color:var(--green)}
  .mini-scale{position:relative;height:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden}
  .mini-zone-ok{position:absolute;left:42%;right:42%;top:0;bottom:0;background:rgba(57,211,95,.12);border-radius:999px}
  .mini-scale-pin{position:absolute;top:-3px;width:2px;height:18px;background:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(57,211,95,.5);transform:translateX(-50%);transition:left .2s ease}
  .mini-scale-labels{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);margin-top:8px}
  .mini-scale-labels span{white-space:nowrap}
  .mini-scale-note{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.4}
  .pip-tray-card{background:rgba(6,11,6,.99);border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.14);border-radius:10px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;justify-content:space-between;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:460px}
  .pip-tray-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 4px,rgba(57,211,95,.013) 4px,rgba(57,211,95,.013) 5px);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
  .pip-ring{width:100%;max-width:210px;display:block;position:relative;z-index:1;margin:0 auto}
  .pip-tray-info{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--text);text-align:center;margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .pip-tray-leds{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
  .pip-tray-led{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--muted);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:1px 6px;border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.14);border-radius:999px}
  .pip-tray-led i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border2);display:inline-block}
  .pip-tray-led.on{color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.35)}
  .pip-tray-led.on i{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--green)}
  .pip-tray-led.move{color:var(--yellow);border-color:rgba(234,179,8,.35)}
  .pip-tray-led.move i{background:var(--yellow);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--yellow)}
  .pip-tray-led.lock{color:var(--accent2);border-color:rgba(124,106,247,.35)}
  .pip-tray-led.lock i{background:var(--accent2);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--accent2)}
  .pip-tray-summary{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:10px;padding:14px;border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.12);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(17,28,17,.9)}
  .pip-tray-controls{width:100%;margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.12);padding-top:16px;position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  .pip-tray-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
  .pip-tray-head.power-on{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border:1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.18);border-radius:14px;padding:10px}
  .pip-tray-head.power-off{background:rgba(239,68,68,.08);border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.18);border-radius:14px;padding:10px}
  .pip-tray-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:10px 0}
  .pip-tray-card.lockdown{border-color:rgba(124,106,247,.45);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(124,106,247,.14)}
  .pip-stat-item.on{background:rgba(34,197,94,.08);border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.18)}
  .pip-stat-item.off{background:rgba(239,68,68,.08);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.18)}
  .pip-mini{background:rgba(17,28,17,.9);border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.12);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px}
  .pip-mini-k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase}
  .pip-mini-v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--text);margin-top:2px}
  .control-hint{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);margin-top:4px}
  .motion-spin{display:inline-block;animation:spin 1s linear infinite}
  @keyframes spin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
  #card-tray0,#card-tray1{display:none}
  .pip-status-col{background:rgba(6,11,6,.98);border:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.18);border-radius:14px;padding:18px;min-width:155px;display:grid;gap:14px}
  .pip-status-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--accent);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.08)}
  .pip-stat-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.08)}
  .pip-stat-item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .pip-stat-key{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(57,211,95,.55);max-width:70%}
  .pip-stat-val{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--text);text-shadow:0 0 4px rgba(57,211,95,.14);min-width:48px;text-align:right}
  .gpio-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;font-size:11px;font-family:var(--mono);margin-bottom:12px}
  .gpio-item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(57,211,95,.08);padding:4px 0;gap:8px}
  .gpio-name{color:var(--muted)}
  .gpio-pin code{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0 4px;border-radius:3px;color:var(--accent)}
  .master-btns{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
  .master-btns .btn{flex:1;text-align:center}
  .kal-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:270px 1fr 270px;gap:14px;align-items:start}
  @media(max-width:960px){.kal-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
  @media(max-width:600px){.kal-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  .kal-card{background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:10px;padding:14px}
  .kal-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px}
  .kal-clock{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:44px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--accent);text-align:center;margin:10px 0 4px;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(57,211,95,.4);line-height:1}
  .kal-clock-sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px}
  .kal-btn-row{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between}
  .kal-btn{padding:10px 16px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border2);cursor:pointer;font-family:var(--font);flex:1 1 120px;min-width:90px;text-align:center;transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,background .15s ease}
  .kal-btn:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
  .kal-btn:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
  .kal-btn-start{background:rgba(57,211,95,.18);color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(57,211,95,.4)}
  .kal-btn-stop{background:rgba(239,68,68,.16);color:var(--hot);border-color:rgba(239,68,68,.35)}
  .kal-btn-lap{background:rgba(245,166,35,.16);color:var(--yellow);border-color:rgba(245,166,35,.35)}
  .kal-btn-reset{background:rgba(127,167,134,.12);color:var(--muted);border-color:var(--border)}
  .kal-laps{max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto;margin-top:10px}
  .kal-lap-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:11px;font-family:var(--mono)}
  .kal-lap-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .kal-lap-label{color:var(--text);font-size:11px}
  .kal-lap-pwm{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
  .kal-lap-time{color:var(--accent);font-weight:500}
  #kal-canvas{display:block;margin:0 auto;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);border-radius:8px}
  .kal-angle-info{text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
  .kal-phase-btns{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px;margin-top:8px}
  .kal-phase-btn{padding:6px 8px;font-size:10px;font-family:var(--mono);letter-spacing:.04em;border-radius:5px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:all .15s}
  .kal-phase-btn.sel{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:rgba(57,211,95,.08)}
  .kal-pwm-big{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:36px;font-weight:300;color:var(--text);text-align:center;margin:6px 0 2px}
  .kal-pwm-presets{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;margin-top:6px}
  .kal-preset{padding:4px 10px;font-size:11px;font-family:var(--mono);border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
  .kal-preset:hover,.kal-preset.active{border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent);background:rgba(57,211,95,.08)}
  .kal-result-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;margin-top:8px}
  .kal-result-table th{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;padding:5px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:left;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
  .kal-result-table td{padding:5px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,58,37,.5);vertical-align:top}
  .kal-result-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
  .kal-result-table .hi{color:var(--accent);font-weight:500}
  .kal-result-table .med{color:var(--yellow)}
  .kal-result-table .lo{color:var(--muted)}
  .kal-result-table .del-btn{cursor:pointer;color:var(--hot);font-size:10px;padding:2px 4px;border:none;background:none;opacity:.6}
  .kal-result-table .del-btn:hover{opacity:1}
  .kal-calc{background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px}
  .kal-calc-title{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
  .kal-calc-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:4px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(31,58,37,.4);font-size:11px}
  .kal-calc-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
  .kal-calc-k{color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono)}
  .kal-calc-v{color:var(--text);font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:500}
  .kal-calc-v.accent{color:var(--accent)}
  .kal-pos-btns{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px;justify-content:center}
  .kal-pos-btn{padding:5px 10px;font-size:10px;font-family:var(--mono);border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg3);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s}
  .kal-pos-btn:hover{border-color:var(--muted);color:var(--text)}
  .kal-move-row{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
  .kal-pref-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto auto auto;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px}
  .kal-pref-grid .h{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .kal-pref-grid input[type="number"]{width:70px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px}
  .kal-pref-grid input[type="checkbox"]{transform:translateY(1px)}
  .kal-pref-json{width:100%;min-height:88px;background:var(--bg3);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text);padding:8px;border-radius:6px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;resize:vertical}
  .kal-pref-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
  .gauge-section.hidden{display:none !important; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; max-height:0;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="topbar"><div class="topbar-left"><div class="topbar-logo">INCUBATOR CONTROL SYSTEM v1.0</div><div class="topbar-sep"></div><div class="topbar-stat"><div class="dot ok" id="apiDot"></div><span>API</span><strong id="apiStatusTop">--</strong><span id="apiStatusBadge" class="badge badge-hot" style="display:none;margin-left:8px">OFFLINE</span></div><div class="topbar-sep"></div><div class="topbar-stat"><div class="dot" id="espDot"></div><span>ESP</span><strong id="espTempTop">--°C</strong></div><div class="topbar-sep"></div><div class="topbar-stat"><span>KOMORA</span><strong id="chamberTempTop">--°C</strong><span class="topbar-sub" id="targetTempTop">/ --°C</span></div></div><div class="topbar-center" id="topbarBadges"></div><div class="topbar-right"><div class="topbar-stat"><span>Czas</span><strong id="topClock">--:--:--</strong></div></div></header>
<nav class="tabs">
  <button class="tab active" data-tab="status" onclick="showTab('status')">Status</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="panel" onclick="showTab('panel')">Wykresy</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="harmonogram" onclick="showTab('harmonogram')">Harmonogram</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="dziennik" onclick="showTab('dziennik')">Dziennik Inkubacji</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="esp" onclick="showTab('esp')">ESP, okablowanie i zabezpieczenia</button>
  <button class="tab" onclick="window.location.href='/docs-v1-1'">Dokumentacja v1.1</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="logi" onclick="showTab('logi')">Logi zdarzeń</button>
  <button class="tab" data-tab="kalibracja" onclick="showTab('kalibracja')">⚙ Kalibracja Tacy</button>
</nav>

<div id="view-status" class="view active main">
  <div class="pip-header">
    <div>
      <div class="pip-logo">HATCH OPS // TACTICAL INCUBATION CONTROL</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- GŁÓWNE PARAMETRY -->
  <div class="pip-row-big" style="margin-bottom:16px">
    <div class="pip-gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-chamber" class="pip-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="pip-gauge-title">Temperatura komory</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pip-gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-hum" class="pip-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="pip-gauge-title">DHT11 WILGOTNOŚĆ</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pip-gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-ds18" class="pip-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="pip-gauge-title">DS18B20 #1 / #2</div>
      <div class="pip-gauge-subvals"><span id="pip-ds18-val0">--°C</span><span id="pip-ds18-val1">--°C</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pip-gauge-card">
      <canvas id="pip-esp" class="pip-canvas"></canvas>
      <div class="pip-gauge-title">ESP32-S3 CORE</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="pip-osc-section">
    <div class="section-label">Oscylator statusu</div>
    <div class="pip-osc-card">
      <div class="card-header" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px">
        <div>
          <div class="card-title">Aktualna temperatura komory</div>
          <div class="metric-sub">Czarna linia = trend wartości, zielony pas = zakres celu, biała linia = zadana wartość.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="pip-osc-legend">
          <div class="pip-osc-key"><span class="line-actual"></span>Aktualna wartość</div>
          <div class="pip-osc-key"><span class="band-range"></span>Zakres celu</div>
          <div class="pip-osc-key"><span class="line-target"></span>Cel</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <canvas id="pip-osc-temp" class="pip-osc-canvas"></canvas>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="pip-offset-row">
    <div class="pip-indicator-card">
      <div class="pip-indicator-title">ΔT — odchyłka</div>
      <div class="pip-indicator-value" id="delta-temp-value">--</div>
      <div class="mini-scale"><div class="mini-zone-ok"></div><div class="mini-scale-pin" id="delta-temp-pin"></div></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-labels"><span>-1</span><span>-0.5</span><span>0</span><span>+0.5</span><span>+1</span></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-note">środek = idealna temperatura</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pip-indicator-card">
      <div class="pip-indicator-title">ΔH — wilgotność</div>
      <div class="pip-indicator-value" id="delta-hum-value">--</div>
      <div class="mini-scale"><div class="mini-zone-ok"></div><div class="mini-scale-pin" id="delta-hum-pin"></div></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-labels"><span>SUCHO</span><span></span><span>OK</span><span></span><span>MOKRO</span></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-note">zielona strefa = optymalna wilgotność</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pip-indicator-card">
      <div class="pip-indicator-title">Moc grzania</div>
      <div class="pip-indicator-value" id="heater-load-value">--%</div>
      <div class="mini-scale"><div class="mini-scale-pin" id="heater-load-pin"></div></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-labels"><span>0%</span><span>50%</span><span></span><span></span><span>100%</span></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-note">wysokie = wysiłek regulatora</div>
    </div>
    <div class="pip-indicator-card">
      <div class="pip-indicator-title">Równowaga komory</div>
      <div class="pip-indicator-value" id="chamber-balance-value">--</div>
      <div class="mini-scale"><div class="mini-zone-ok"></div><div class="mini-scale-pin" id="chamber-balance-pin"></div></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-labels"><span>góra ciepła</span><span></span><span>wyrównana</span><span></span><span>dół ciepły</span></div>
      <div class="mini-scale-note">różnica DS1 / DS2</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- STATUS LĘGÓW + KONTROLA MOCY -->
  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 320px;gap:14px">

    <!-- Tace -->
    <div>
      <div class="section-label" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px;color:rgba(57,211,95,.6)">
        <span>STATUS LĘGÓW</span>
        <button class="btn btn-ghost" style="font-size:10px;padding:3px 8px" onclick="showTab('kalibracja')">Kalibracja Tacy</button>
      </div>
      <div class="pip-tray-row status-tray-row">
        <div class="pip-tray-card">
          <canvas id="pip-tray0" class="pip-ring"></canvas>
          <div class="pip-tray-info" id="pip-tray0-info">TACA 1</div>
          <div class="pip-tray-timer" id="pip-tray0-timer" style="margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4"></div>
          <div class="pip-tray-summary">
            <div class="tray-detail" id="status-tray0-summary">Ostatni obrót: --</div>
            <div class="pip-tray-stats"><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Postęp</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray0-progress">--%</div></div><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Do lockdown</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray0-lockleft">--</div></div><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Obrotów / dzień</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray0-rpd">--/--</div></div><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Cykl obrotów</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray0-leftturns">--/--</div></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="pip-tray-controls">
            <div class="pip-tray-head" id="status-tray0-powerrow">
              <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
                <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind-status-tray0"></div>
                <span class="badge badge-info" id="badge-status-tray0-species">--</span>
              </div>
              <label class="pip-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-status-tray0" onchange="toggleTrayPower(0,this.checked)"><span class="pip-slider"></span></label>
            </div>
              <div class="control-row"><div class="control-label">Gatunek</div><select id="status-species-tray0" style="max-width:180px" onchange="syncStatusSpecies(0)"><option value="CHICKEN">Kura (21 dni)</option><option value="DUCK">Kaczka (28 dni)</option><option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option><option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option></select></div>
              <div class="control-row"><div class="control-label">Dzień</div><input type="number" id="status-day-tray0" value="1" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:80px"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-status-day0" onclick="setTrayDayStatus(0)">Ustaw</button></div>
              <div class="control-row"><div class="control-label">Ruch (czas)</div><input type="number" id="status-dur-tray0" value="15000" min="500" max="600000" step="500" style="max-width:110px"><div class="slider-val" style="min-width:24px">ms</div></div>
              <div class="control-row"><div class="control-label">Moc PWM</div><input type="range" min="0" max="225" value="90" id="status-spd-tray0" list="pwm-scale" oninput="document.getElementById('status-spd-val0').textContent=this.value"><div class="slider-val" id="status-spd-val0">90</div></div>
              <div class="control-hint" id="status-spd-rec0">Rekom.: --</div>
              <div class="control-hint">PWM = prędkość silnika (0-225).</div>
              <button class="btn btn-primary btn-full" id="btn-status-move0" onclick="moveTrayStatus(0)">▶ Uruchom Tacę 1</button>
              <button class="btn btn-danger btn-full" id="btn-status-stop0" onclick="stopTray(0)">■ Zatrzymaj Tacę 1</button>
              <div class="tray-detail" id="status-tray0-motion">⏸ Bezczynna</div>
              <div class="status-msg" id="st-status-day0"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
      <div class="pip-tray-card">
          <canvas id="pip-tray1" class="pip-ring"></canvas>
          <div class="pip-tray-info" id="pip-tray1-info">TACA 2 (OFF)</div>
          <div class="pip-tray-timer" id="pip-tray1-timer" style="margin-top:8px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4"></div>
          <div class="pip-tray-summary">
            <div class="tray-detail" id="status-tray1-summary">Ostatni obrót: --</div>
            <div class="pip-tray-stats"><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Postęp</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray1-progress">--%</div></div><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Do lockdown</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray1-lockleft">--</div></div><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Obrotów / dzień</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray1-rpd">--/--</div></div><div class="pip-mini"><div class="pip-mini-k">Cykl obrotów</div><div class="pip-mini-v" id="status-tray1-leftturns">--/--</div></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="pip-tray-controls">
            <div class="pip-tray-head" id="status-tray1-powerrow">
              <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px">
                <div class="tray-indicator" id="ind-status-tray1"></div>
                <span class="badge badge-info" id="badge-status-tray1-species">--</span>
              </div>
              <label class="pip-switch"><input type="checkbox" id="sw-status-tray1" onchange="toggleTrayPower(1,this.checked)"><span class="pip-slider"></span></label>
            </div>
              <div class="control-row"><div class="control-label">Gatunek</div><select id="status-species-tray1" style="max-width:180px" onchange="syncStatusSpecies(1)"><option value="CHICKEN">Kura (21 dni)</option><option value="DUCK">Kaczka (28 dni)</option><option value="GOOSE">Gęś (30 dni)</option><option value="QUAIL">Przepiórka (17 dni)</option><option value="GUINEA">Perliczka (26 dni)</option><option value="PHEASANT">Bażant (24 dni)</option></select></div>
              <div class="control-row"><div class="control-label">Dzień</div><input type="number" id="status-day-tray1" value="1" min="1" max="40" style="max-width:80px"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="btn-status-day1" onclick="setTrayDayStatus(1)">Ustaw</button></div>
